jobs.title: Project Manager, Design Team
jobs.description:
**Project Manager, Design Team**

**About Us**

At AlfaTech we believe in more than just engineering solutions; we believe in promoting a culture of agility, collaboration, and inclusion. As a leading consulting engineering firm, we provide thoughtful engineering design that is technologically forward thinking, innovative, and environmentally conscious, ensuring that our contribution to our built environment is flexible, sustainable, and lasting across all the market segments we serve.

  

If you're driven by a passion for engineering, innovation, and making a difference, if you thrive on challenges and adapt quickly to change, and if you are looking to be part of a dynamic team of empowered, smart, energized, professionals, then AlfaTech is the place for you.

  

**Job Summary**

As the Design Team Project Manager, you will provide a very high level of technical leadership and direction to the project team to ensure successful completion of projects. The candidate will represent the firm in all interactions with clients, contractors, and other project team members. In this role, you will oversee the complete design project team in the design of the building, including in-house mechanical, electrical plumbing, and technology systems, as well as sub-consultant team members such as architects, structural and civil engineers.

  

This is a senior-level position that requires a self-motivated individual with strong organizational, communication, and leadership skills. The successful candidate will be highly analytical, possess exceptional problem-solving skills, can multi-task, work independently, and as a productive and engaged team member in a fast-paced environment.

  

**This candidate will be required to report to our San Jose or San Francisco office on a hybrid basis.**

  

**Core Responsibilities**

* Coordinate project designs, evaluations, and studies.
* Quality control review of designs prepared by others.
* Lead project team in design change management.
* Coordinate and assemble overall design team proposals, including estimating in-house engineering.
* Manage contract administration, scheduling, and costing.
* Establish project budgets and schedules.
* Track project timelines, expenditures, and project deliverables and report to client and AlfaTech Management.
* Orchestrate and lead project kick-off meetings, coordination meetings, and design review meetings for the project team.
* Manage tasks as required to ensure that work is completed on time and within budget.
* Communicate directly with clients and act as the primary point of contact for AlfaTech.
* Coordinate, support, and communicate with colleagues across disciplines.
* Lead interactions with local municipalities and with contractor teams for permitting and construction activities.
* Monitor and manage the project contracted responsibilities to ensure services provided agree with contracted services and prepare additional service requests if needed.
* Maintain client relationships through prompt response to needs and questions, initiating contact when information is needed, or delays are imminent.
* Staff oversight and mentoring.
* Capable of working in the field on a construction site.
* Arrange construction site walkthroughs and lead project team meetings.
* Ensure that the client’s specified performance criteria are met.
* Other duties as assigned.

  

*This is meant to summarize the role’s responsibilities and provide some information and structure. At AlfaTech we encourage our staff to think outside the box and explore opportunities beyond the confines of ones stated responsibilities to bring new thoughts, ideas and innovations to our company.*

  
  

**Ideal Candidate**

* Demonstrated experience as a self-directed, pro-active, and highly motivated team leader.
* Detail-orientated with high levels of Math accuracy.
* Good problem solving and decision-making skills, and the ability to meet deadlines.
* Strong interpersonal and customer service skills and demonstrated ability to communicate with internal and external business partners.
* Solid knowledge of codes, standards, and construction/engineering processes.
* Proclivity for catching the error and enacting appropriate changes.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe Acrobat, Revit, AutoCAD, Bluebeam, SharePoint, and Procore.
* Professional Engineer (PE) License or Architectural (AIA) License preferred.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification preferred.
* LEED Accreditation and/or WELL Certification preferred.
* Data Center experience preferred.

  

**Essential Requirements**

* Superior interpersonal communication skills.
* Superior written communication skills.
* Experience working on large-scale design and construction projects.
* Experience working on highly technical design and construction projects such as Mission Critical, Cleanroom, or Manufacturing projects.
* Minimum of ten to fifteen years of direct experience working with an architectural firm or consulting engineering firm.
* 5 years of experience managing a team of multiple building design disciplines
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or architecture or equivalent combination of work experience and relevant education.

  

**Salary Range**

This is a hybrid role. It is anticipated that the working days in the office will be done at our San Francisco or San Jose, CA offices. The expected salary range for candidates who will work in San Francisco, CA is $130,000 - $165,000. The final offer to our new team member will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to the length, breadth, and depth of experience within the job and the industry, education, etc. ATCE is a multi-state employer, and this salary range may not reflect positions that work in other states

  

**This candidate will be required to report to our San Jose or San Francisco office on a hybrid basis.**

jobs.title: Program Leader - Aptos
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  
  
The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life. Our services include academic support and college counseling, job placement and employment training, substance use and violence prevention education, crisis intervention and mediation, leadership development, technology and computer training. Our mission is to encourage a diverse population of high-need young people to explore their full potential through academic, career, family, and community life.

**Title:****Program Leader**

**Salary:****$23.50-$27.00/Hour**

**Reports to:****Site Coordinator/Beacon Director**

**Status:** **Part****-Time, Non-Exempt (school year end: 6/2/2027)**

**POSITION DESCRIPTION:**

Under the supervision of the Site Coordinator, the Program Leader is responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing a variety of academic and enrichment activities targeting middle school youth at the CYC Aptos Beacon Center. This includes designing curriculum and activities which incorporate skill building and project based learning that are fun and engaging for youth.

We are looking for multiple staff to teach one or more of the following enrichment activities:

* Arts (i.e. painting, drawing, crafting, etc.)
* Mixed Sports (i.e. soccer, basketball, table tennis, skateboarding, etc.)
* Performing Arts (i.e. drama, voice, dance, etc.)
* Cooking, Gardening, Cultural Arts and Exploration
* Academic Tutoring
* Career & College Awareness
* STEAM (i.e. coding, 3D printing, game design, robotics, video/music production, etc.)

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Develop, implement, and oversee a variety of skill building and project based learning activities for middle school aged youth.
* Provide academic tutoring and assist students with their daily homework as needed.
* Establish and maintain a positive and safe learning environment for program participants including assisting with classroom and behavior management, resolving and mediating conflicts using restorative practices, handling emergencies and injuries, etc.
* Create marketing strategies and promotional materials to recruit and retain youth in afterschool programs.
* Collaborate with school and Beacon staff to coordinate cultural celebrations and culminating events that builds community and celebrates youth accomplishments.
* Work with school faculty and parents/guardians to maintain a high level of communication and positive relationships/climate between school, beacon and families.
* Assist with data collection and produce programmatic reports as requested.
* Assist with administering and collecting evaluation data as required by funders and for continuous program improvement.
* Participate in regular staff meetings and attend on-going training opportunities as needed.
* Maintain the cleanliness and organization of all shared program spaces.
* Complete other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree preferred or must have completed a minimum of 48 college units or passed an Instructional Aide Exam.
* Knowledge of youth development practices and one or more years of experience planning and facilitating enrichment activities for youth.
* Experience in classroom management, conflict mediation, and restorative practices is a plus.
* Experience working with ethnically diverse youth and families who have experienced poverty, crisis, trauma, and other adverse events is a plus.
* Ability to develop, implement, and organize programs and special events.
* Possess good organizational, communication and teamwork skills.
* Capacity to multitask, work independently, and meet strict programmatic deadlines.
* Good technology skills (familiar with Google docs & sheets, MS Office, etc.)
* Ability to model to staff and participants: professionalism, personal responsibility, a strong work ethic and positive character.
* Bilingual in Cantonese/Mandarin, Spanish, or Tagalog is preferred.
* Able to lift or move at least 25lbs.

CYC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, age, religion, gender, marital status, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other basis recognized by federal, state, or local law, including on the basis of the intersection of two or more protected characteristics, also known as intersectional discrimination. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment.

jobs.description:
**The group you’ll be a part of**
---------------------------------

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.

**The impact you’ll make**
--------------------------

This role will have a high-profile presence within the Deposition Product Group (DPG) and will drive measurable improvements in business operations through strong quality program management and sustained execution of strategic quality initiatives. The individual will lead cross-functional quality programs, accelerate 8D cycle-time reduction, improve supplier failure analysis effectiveness, and proactively advance DPG quality execution. This role will directly contribute to multi-million-dollar cost savings that will be reinvested into future growth, product development, and data-driven business decision-making, while reducing customer-visible risk.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Lead and sustain DPG quality strategic initiatives, owning execution cadence, milestones, risk management, and measurable outcomes across assigned programs.
* Partner with DPG Quality stakeholders and the analytics team to track and manage key KPIs, quality program critical deliverables, identify trends and gaps, and deliver clear, executive-level reporting.
* Drive alignment across Quality, Engineering, SET, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Suppliers to improve end-to-end DPG quality performance.
* Facilitate and lead cross-functional teams (CFTs) to address systemic quality issues and accelerate the transition from reactive issue management to proactive risk prevention.
* Collaborate with Install & Warranty and Inventory program managers to analyze data trends and patterns, driving targeted improvements in key performance indicators.
* Expand the impact and maturity of Cost of Quality by correlating I&W data, ECOGS, and quality events to identify causal relationships and uncover hidden costs across the network.
* Lead and/or advise on multiple concurrent initiatives, demonstrating strong organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills in a fast-paced environment.

* Deep working knowledge of 8D/RCCA methodologies, failure analysis, supplier quality processes, and KPI-driven performance management, with demonstrated ability to manage high-complexity workloads in fast-paced environments.
* Proven ability to define clear problem statements and objectives, develop structured analytical approaches, and execute data-driven analyses to drive decisions and outcomes.
* Strong experience leading cross-functional teams, demonstrating effective leadership, influence, and accountability to deliver results.
* Ability to influence and drive alignment within a fast-paced, matrixed, cross-functional organization.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, interpersonal, and influencing skills.
* Extensive knowledge of Lean Six Sigma methodologies, statistical analysis, and quality systems.

* Ownership mindset with a bias for action to drive solutions and positive business outcomes.
* Excellent written and verbal presentation skills, capable of engaging audiences at multiple organizational levels.
* Willingness and ability to benchmark and adapt best practices to continuously improve quality execution.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

**Case Manager II - Canyon Vista**

Telecare continues to advance cultural diversity, humility, equity, and inclusion at all levels of our organization by hiring mental health peers, BIPOC, LGBTQIA+, veterans, and all belief systems.

Canyon Vista is a 57 unit transitional and permanent supportive housing (PSH) program serving adults in San Mateo County with serious mental illness. Services onsite will be available 24 hours a day, 7 days per week.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Program Manager of the Centralized Job Center (CJC) is responsible for running Goodwill’s Centralized Job Center in San Francisco, which is an America’s Job Center of California (AJCC). The position leads a team and the strategic direction of CJC with the goal of providing job placement, training, barrier removal, and retention services to clients.

This position will be overseeing a team providing intensive career coaching support, assessments, and job placement services to dislocated workers, people seeking retraining, and others starting work for the first time. Other responsibilities will include managing program performance, growing our program’s footprint, building strong partnerships with community-based organizations, local and state government agencies, and industry leaders. They will also develop and cultivate public and philanthropic partnerships within the Office of Workforce Development in San Francisco that support Goodwill’s mission. This position will collaborate closely with the Mission Advancement leadership team and reports to the Director of Career Services.

* Recruit, hire, and supervise a diverse team of direct service staff at the CJC
* Train staff on best practices and Goodwill processes to improve service delivery to clients and partners

* Identify and create opportunities for professional development and growth for staff
* As a member of Goodwill’s Mission Advancement Leadership Team, accurately present issues that impact your ability to achieve maximum results, provide recommendations, problem solve and implement solutions to achieve outcomes.

* 10 years of experience in data analytics, trust and safety, policy, anti-abuse messaging solutions, fraud/abuse investigations, risk management, or a related field.
* 3 years of experience in leading and developing teams.
* 3 years of experience with product launch or program management.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in fraud investigations, risk management, and threat analysis for communication products.
* Experience building technical or product-based anti-abuse messaging solutions.
* Experience in operations and Trust and Safety, including leading fast-moving teams.
* Experience in large-scale data analysis and processes for developing ML reputation models.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and leadership.
* Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills with attention to the evolving abuse landscape.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust and Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.

The RCS for Business (RBM) Messaging Spam and Abuse team works on preventing abuse within the RBM ecosystem (Business to user, and User to business).

We are responsible for keeping our partners safe from malicious content (phishing, malware, scams) and unwanted interactions (spam). Over the next few years, we intend to scale up the protections across the ecosystem, in partnership with product and engineering teams, with a focused goal of de-risking RCS value to the business ecosystem overall.

In this role, you will understand the user's point of view and be passionate about using your technical, investigative, and strategic acumen to protect our users. You will work globally and cross-functionally with Google Engineers and Product Managers to navigate challenging online safety situations and manage abuse and fraud at Google scale.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $171000 - $247000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Identify Business-to-Users and Users-to-Business threats, working cross-functionally, designing and building anti-abuse protections. Influence safer-by-design product features, and advise on counter-abuse strategies and emerging trends.
* Analyze data and trends to identify signals for scaled enforcement, leading projects to increase the adoption of AI/ML to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.
* Design and operate the full Trust and Safety funnel of review, enforcement, and appeals workflows. Ensure effective policy implementation by drafting guidelines for reviewers and overseeing review and enforcement quality. Build and scale lean operational processes, deploying automation first strategies.
* Provide abuse and policy expertise to Product, Engineering, and other teams, supporting the development of automated enforcement solutions.
* Monitor ecosystem performance against key metrics, investigating anomalies in spam trends, identifying root causes. Manage industry partner-experience trends, and executive escalations by providing timely, data- and content-driven insights.

jobs.title: Assistant Farmers Market Manager-Clement St
jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY**

The Agricultural Institute of Marin is seeking a dedicated part-time Assistant Farmers Market Manager for our year-round farmers market that occurs every Sunday on Clement St in San Francisco. The Assistant Farmers Market Manager assures the smooth operation of the farmers market by assisting the Market Manager in setup and breakdown of the market and by providing excellent customer service in the Information Booth. This is an entry-level position with potential for a career pathway in farmers markets operations, agricultural education, or local food systems strategies.

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Assist the Market Manager with all aspects of market operations, including securing the site and overseeing market setup and breakdown.

* Set up, maintain, and break down market equipment, including ATM(s), signage, information booth, restrooms, entertainment areas, café seating, and waste diversion stations (recycling, compost, and garbage).

* Staff the information booth, providing excellent customer service and processing customer transactions.

* Operate AIM's EBT program, including processing EBT transactions and distributing tokens for eligible food purchases.

* Foster positive relationships with vendors, customers, staff, community organizations, local businesses, and government representatives.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Must be at least 21 years of age.

* Valid California driver's license with a clean driving record.

* Ability to lift and move up to 50 lbs. repeatedly and load/unload equipment from a truck.

* Strong communication, organizational, problem-solving, and multitasking skills with exceptional attention to detail.

* Ability to remain calm and professional in a fast-paced environment.

* Positive, outgoing attitude with a strong sense of teamwork, initiative, and accountability.

* Reliable attendance and punctuality.

* General knowledge of, or genuine interest in, food systems, agriculture, and farmers markets.

* Ability to work early mornings and extended shifts (approximately 6:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m each Sunday,  
  rain or shine)

  

**HIGHLY PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bilingual in Spanish or Cantonese

  

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS/DEMANDS**

This position regularly requires:

* Lifting, carrying, loading, and unloading market equipment weighing 50+ lbs., including tables, chairs, canopies, canopy weights, ATM equipment, barricades, cones, A-frames, and signage.

* Setting up and dismantling market infrastructure and customer service areas.

* Handling garbage, compost, and recycling throughout the market day.

* Walking, standing, bending, twisting, and sitting for extended periods.

* Maintaining clean, safe, and sanitary conditions in a busy outdoor environment.

  

**ABOUT** **AIM**

The Agricultural Institute of Marin is an educational 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization headquartered in San Rafael, California. AIM’s mission is to educate, inspire, and connect communities, farmers, and producers in order to create a healthy, Earth-friendly, equitable local and regional food and agricultural system envision a responsible food and farming system that is environmentally beneficial, economically viable, and socially just. AIM runs Certified Farmers Markets in Hayward, Newark, Oakland, Point Reyes, San Rafael, and San Francisco, serving more than 400 farmers, food makers, and artisans from 40 California counties. We also offer hands-on and virtual education programs for thousands of children and adults, run a farm audit program, operate a mobile market for older adults and underserved communities, and provide CalFresh/EBT and Market Match services to build a healthier, more equitable food system across the San Francisco Bay Area.

  

**DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION**

AIM embraces diversity and equal opportunity. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

  

**WE ALSO LOOK FOR PEOPLE WHO**

* **Value inclusion:** listen well, treat everyone with respect, use inclusive language, and support fair access for all.

* **Work as a team:** share responsibility, support coworkers, take part in meetings, raise issues early, and keep building their skills.

* **Proactively s****olve problems:** analyze issues, try new approaches, ask for help when needed, and pre-emptively suggest improvements.

* **Communicate well:** listen actively, adapt their style, stay open, share key information, and resolve conflicts promptly.

* **Put customers first:** act on feedback, respond quickly, stay courteous, keep work areas clean, and recycle properly.

We raised an $80M Series A led by Spark Capital and Transformation Capital, with General Catalyst, McKesson Ventures, Conviction, and Y Combinator. 60+ health systems run on Latent, including Yale New Haven, Mount Sinai, UCSF, and Ochsner. **Required**

* 5+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, or a similar post-sale role
* Experience supporting health systems, hospitals, or enterprise healthcare customers
* Proven success driving renewals and expansion in complex, regulated environments
* Strong executive presence with excellent cross-functional communication skills

**Preferred**

* Experience with healthcare IT, AI/ML platforms, or clinical workflow tools
* Familiarity with hospital operations, pharmacy, clinical informatics, or quality programs
* Experience working with multiple stakeholder personas and long sales or adoption cycles

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Comfort pushing the pace — Latent moves quickly, and adaptability is essential
* A collaborative mindset paired with clear, thoughtful communication
* A proactive, ownership-driven approach to problem-solving in a high-growth environment
* A strong work ethic with a commitment to quality, rigor, and attention to detail

**Why Join Latent**
-------------------

* Backed by top-tier investors including General Catalyst, Conviction, and Y Combinator
* Work alongside a high-caliber team building products our healthcare partners love
* Work on mission-critical problems at the intersection of AI and healthcare
* Real ownership and visibility
* High-impact role on a small, fast-growing team

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents
* Flexible PTO policy

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Large Enterprise
jobs.description:
**About the role and team**  
  
Working as a Customer Success Manager at Uber means moving beyond the polished surface of account management to solve the complex, high-stakes operational realities our largest enterprise partners face every day. You will be the bridge between our digital platform and the physical storefronts of our most important enterprise partners, ensuring that Uber remains their preferred delivery engine through relentless analytical rigor and hands-on problem solving.  
  
The pace is intense and the environment is frequently ambiguous, requiring a mindset that thrives when there is no established playbook. This role is for those who take extreme ownership of partner outcomes, possess the grit to navigate internal friction, and are energized by the challenge of turning complex data into real-world marketplace reliability. If you prefer a predictable, transactional routine over the rewarding but demanding work of scaling global partnerships, this may not be the right fit for you.  
  
**What you'll do**

* Build and grow long-term partnerships by deeply understanding what matters most to our enterprise customers, moving beyond simple product support to deliver tangible business value.
* Navigate internal complexity and cross-functional tension to advocate for product enhancements and unblock operational bottlenecks for your partners.
* Solve messy, high-impact problems using data-driven insights to identify patterns that impact experience at scale.
* Adapt your strategy based on shifting market dynamics and imperfect information to ensure partners see consistent ROI and platform reliability.
* Champion operational excellence by identifying and reducing "operational debt" while maintaining a high quality bar for your portfolio.
* Lead cross-functional collaborations with operations, product, and legal teams to shape and deliver solutions that scale.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of client-facing experience in account management, customer success, or consulting.
* Proficiency in data analysis and using Excel to drive business judgment and decision-making.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proficiency in SQL to independently extract insights from large-scale datasets.
* Experience managing stakeholders across diverse business functions and levels.
* Demonstrated systems thinking with the ability to turn unstructured, ambiguous problems into focused execution plans.
* Experience in the technology or food delivery industry managing high-pressure projects.
* Proven ability to influence without authority and navigate complex interpersonal dynamics.

  
For Chicago, IL-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $107,000 per year - USD $119,000 per year.  
  
For Dallas, TX-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $107,000 per year - USD $119,000 per year.  
  
For Miami, FL-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $107,000 per year - USD $119,000 per year.  
  
For New York City, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $119,000 per year - USD $132,000 per year.  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $119,000 per year - USD $132,000 per year.  
  
For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

jobs.title: Lead Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.

***There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.***

At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And, over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.

***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.***

 **Job Description**

At Freshworks, we're on a mission to help businesses delight their customers and employees through simple, powerful software. As we continue to grow our Enterprise business, we're looking for a Customer Success Manager to own a portfolio of Key and Enterprise customers across North America.

You'll serve as a strategic partner to your customers, helping them maximize the value of their Freshworks investment while driving adoption, retention, and long-term growth. You'll work closely with customer stakeholders and internal teams to proactively manage risk, strengthen executive relationships, and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

**What You'll Do**

* Own a portfolio of approximately 30-35 Key and Enterprise customers representing $5M-$7M in ARR.
* Build trusted relationships with business, technical, and executive stakeholders
* Drive adoption, value realization, customer health, retention, and renewal readiness
* Lead Executive Business Reviews, success planning, and other strategic customer engagements
* Proactively identify customer risk and coordinate cross-functional teams to drive resolution
* Partner closely with Account Executives on account strategy, renewals, and expansion opportunities
* Identify opportunities to deepen customer relationships and expand the value customers receive from Freshworks
* Collaborate across Product, Engineering, Support, and Professional Services to deliver successful customer outcomes
* Travel as needed for executive engagements and onsite customer meetings

  
**Qualifications**

**What We're Looking For**

* 5+ years of relevant customer-facing SaaS experience, including experience managing strategic or enterprise customers
* Demonstrated success driving customer adoption, retention, renewals, and growth
* Experience building relationships with both technical and business stakeholders, including executives
* Strong commercial mindset with experience partnering on renewals and expansion
* Experience leading EBRs/QBRs and navigating complex customer relationships
* Strong communication, presentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills
* Proactive, hands-on approach with the ability to navigate multiple priorities

  
**Additional Information**

This is a hybrid position based at our San Mateo, CA headquarters, with an expectation of working onsite Tuesday through Thursday. Regular travel is required to support executive customer engagements, strategic business reviews, and onsite meetings.

The annual base salary range for this position is $112,000 - $145,000 USD. This role is eligible for a target bonus and operates under an 80/20 pay mix (80% base salary, 20% variable compensation). Actual compensation will vary based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Freshworks offers multiple options for dental, medical, vision, disability and life insurances, flexible spending, commuter benefits and wellness benefits are also offered. Freshworks also offers adoption and parental leave benefits.

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

jobs.title: Account Manager- Strategic Accounts (Growth & Retention)
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

Rippling’s Strategic Account Managers guide our largest and most strategic customers through a tailored journey. As we rapidly enhance and expand the first-of-its-kind employee management platform, Account Managers champion the voice of the customer within the company and should take an entrepreneurial approach to the role. We're a growing team with massive personal and professional development opportunities.

This role must be based in office: San Francisco, New York, Seattle, Austin, Chicago.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Drive growth and retention for your book of Rippling's largest and most strategic accounts
* Proactively engage customers in your book via key lifecycle events: “go live”, benefits renewal, executive business reviews, contract renewal, etc.
* Field customer requests and advocate for their needs and requirements cross-functionally, with a goal to meet company objectives for adoption, retention, and revenue growth
* Consult with clients to understand their HR, IT, Finance, and global workforce management needs through a solutions-based selling approach
* Drive executive alignment and value with customer decision makers and C-Level executives
* Navigate a sales process by building relationships with multiple stakeholders through remote meetings
* Negotiate and coordinate customer procurement and contract execution
* Drive visibility across Rippling’s leaders (AM, TAM, Product, Customer Support, etc) to highlight customer strategy, needs, risks, and opportunities
* Build and manage a pipeline of new subscription cross-sales, product upgrades, and contract renewals to quarterly targets
* Develop and demonstrate a broad knowledge of current and new Rippling products via executing customer playbooks and prospecting
* Partner with your Technical Account Manager and other Rippling stakeholders to devise account plans, long-term goals, and client strategies; and with cross-functional teams to ensure customer success and secure long-term commitments

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 7-10+ years of SaaS experience in account management, sales, or quota-carrying customer success
* Track record of consistently meeting and exceeding quota via new product sales and upgrades (license or seat expansion sales are not relevant)
* Competitive and creative drive to win alongside customers and think outside of the box to get a deal done
* Demonstrated ability to run sales discovery, demos, and a structured sales process (SPICED or MEDDPICC experience is a bonus)
* Proven success building and maintaining long-term commercial relationships, including experience managing multi-year renewals
* Highly effective communicator with excellent EQ – able to build trust and work well with a diverse group inside and outside the company
* Highly organized, self-motivated, and detail-oriented; great follow-through on projects/tasks big and small
* High integrity; enthusiastic about building a great company for the long term

**Additional information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com.

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive compensation package including benefits + equity.

A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below.

Compensation for this role:

Office Based: $250,000 /year OTE

OTE (60/40 commission split for base/variable pay)

jobs.description:
**Client Care & Operations Coordinator – VetnCare**

The Client Care & Operations Coordinator is a client-facing customer service role at Golden State Pet Cremation, responsible for supporting families with compassionate communication while accurately handling scheduling, documentation, and day-to-day administrative tasks. This role focuses on high-touch client interaction, careful attention to detail, and reliable follow-through, working closely with field and facility teams to ensure services are coordinated smoothly and respectfully.

**A****bout VetnCare:**

Made up of twelve veterinary hospitals situated in Northern California, VetnCare’s vision is to reimagine the local veterinary hospital so our doctors and their teams are empowered to do more advanced care, right here in our own community. Through Golden State Pet Cremation (GSPC), VetnCare supports families with compassionate, dignified end-of-life care, honoring the bond between pets and the people who love them.

**The Role**

* Serve as the primary client contact, providing clear, empathetic communication and timely resolution of questions or concerns.
* Coordinate personalized memorial requests and ensure all client interactions reflect dignity and respect.
* Maintain highly accurate records for cremation services, client files, chain-of-custody documentation, inventory, and required documentation.
* Manage scheduling for witnessed cremations, client appointments, drop-offs, pick-ups, and internal operational needs.

* Support daily operations by coordinating field routes, assisting crematorium technicians, and helping with onboarding logistics.
* Maintain inventory, prepare memorial items, and help maintain a clean, organized, and respectful facility environment.

* Exceptionally organized and detail-driven, with a track record of managing sensitive information and multi-step processes without errors.
* Strong, compassionate communicator with experience in high-touch, client-facing service environments.
* Thrives in fast-paced, multi-step operations and takes initiative to solve problems.
* Collaborative and supportive partner to technicians, field representatives, and leadership.

* Health, dental, and vision insurance

jobs.title: Technical Solutions & Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Bizzaly helps small businesses make technology and AI work for them, without the jargon. We work with local businesses to assess their technology, select the right tools, automate routine work, and implement practical AI and software solutions.

Our clients include businesses in construction, real estate, professional services, and other industries across the Bay Area.

The Role

We're looking for a hands-on technical professional who is comfortable working across small-business IT, cloud applications, integrations, automation, and application support.

Our team handles client relationships, business analysis, and strategy. You'll help turn those recommendations into working solutions.

This is not purely a help-desk role. In addition to supporting client technology, you'll help maintain and troubleshoot Bizzaly's own client-facing applications and integrations.

What You'll Do

* Set up and administer Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, cloud storage, backups, password managers, and other business tools
* Migrate email, files, users, and accounts between systems
* Configure and troubleshoot SaaS applications
* Connect accounting, CRM, scheduling, project-management, and other business systems through APIs and integration tools
* Set up AI tools and build practical automations using platforms such as Zapier or Make
* Troubleshoot integrations, data flows, APIs, and existing web applications
* Help maintain and support Bizzaly-developed client applications
* Work with cloud environments, databases, Git/GitHub repositories, and deployment tools as needed
* Diagnose basic network, server, security, and connectivity issues and identify when specialist support is required
* Document systems, credentials, configurations, and processes clearly
* Explain technology patiently and clearly to non-technical business owners

What We're Looking For

* 4+ years of hands-on technology experience
* Strong experience supporting small-business or business technology environments
* Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365 administration experience
* Experience troubleshooting SaaS applications and integrations
* Understanding of APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, and web applications
* Strong security practices when handling client systems and data
* Ability to independently investigate unfamiliar technology and solve problems
* Excellent communication skills and patience with non-technical clients
* Reliability and clear communication about timelines
* Ability to occasionally visit client offices in the South Bay

Particularly Valuable

You do not need every skill below, but experience in several would be valuable:

* AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
* Python and/or JavaScript
* React or other modern web frameworks
* SQL and/or MongoDB
* REST APIs
* Git/GitHub
* Docker and CI/CD
* QuickBooks and accounting-system integrations
* Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar automation platforms
* AI APIs and tools such as Gemini, ChatGPT, or Claude
* CRM platforms such as Zoho, HubSpot, or Salesforce

The Person We're Looking For

You might currently be a systems engineer, application-support engineer, technical solutions engineer, full-stack developer with strong client skills, or an experienced IT professional who has moved into cloud applications and automation.

We're less concerned with your title than with your ability to figure things out, implement solutions, and explain what you've done in plain English.

Why Work With Us

* Flexible part-time schedule
* Variety: small-business technology, AI, automation, and application work
* Direct interaction with business owners
* Opportunity to help shape Bizzaly's technical capabilities
* Potential to grow into a larger technical role as Bizzaly grows

Pay: From $40.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Sunnyvale, CA 94087

jobs.title: Customer Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**About HUD**
=============

HUD's mission is to build reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI data. We want data to be valuable for the people who create it and trustworthy for the labs that train on it. Our team is a quickly growing group of researchers, engineers and operators building the economy that shapes what AI will become. Backed by $16M from top VCs and YC (W25), our marketplace and platform are used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs.

**About the role**
------------------

We’re looking for a Customer Operations Lead to own the customer-facing work that cannot or should not be automated with AI. You’ll own the systems around successful customer activation and engagement as the implementation counterpart to our GTM Engineers.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own the human-in-the-loop layer of HUD’s operations across our customers - data suppliers (vendors) and frontier labs and enterprises (buyers)
* Jump into customer conversations when a human touch is needed to build trust, clarify context, or move things forward
* Resolve contract, onboarding, and platform blockers by working with the right internal owners
* Turn recurring customer issues, feedback, and learnings into better processes, platform, and communications
* Build lightweight systems that streamline workflows or makes resolving problems easier the next time they occur

**Experience**
--------------

**You may be a good fit if you have:**

* Experience in customer operations, business operations, consulting, or similar roles
* Familiar with CRM tools, external vendor management and AI-native CRM campaigns, email tracking
* Demonstrated judgement in customer-facing situations - you know when to be helpful, when to push back, and when to escalate
* Comfort managing many small but important threads at once
* High attention to detail and strong follow-through
* Used AI tools to improve their productivity

**Strong candidates may also have:**

* Early-stage startup experience with ability to work independently in fast-paced environments
* Experience working with technical customers
* Familiarity with RL, e.g., you know what environments, evals, and benchmarks are
* Thrive in unstructured problem spaces

*We prioritize technical aptitude and learning potential over years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet all criteria.*

**Team & company details**
--------------------------

* **Team Size**: ~25 people currently, mostly full-time in-person, but some remote.
* **Our team:** Our team includes 4 International Olympiad medalists (IOI, ILO, IPhO), serial AI startup founders, and researchers with publications at ICLR, NeurIPS, etc.
* **Company stage:** We have 8 figures in funding and are scaling profitably and quickly to meet very strong demand.

**Logistics**
-------------

* **Employment**: Full-time.
* **Location**: We have offices in San Francisco or Singapore but are open to remote candidates who **can work hours that 70-80% overlap with either San Francisco or Singapore time zones.**
* **Visa Sponsorship**: We provide support for relocation and visas for strong full-time candidates to the US or Singapore.
* **Timeline**: Applications are rolling. The process is 2 technical interviews and a 2-3 day work trial.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive compensation
* 100% covered top-of-the-line medical, dental, and vision from Blue Shield of CA (US employees)
* Lunch and dinner when you’re in the office (in-office employees)
* Company-wide holiday break (Christmas Eve to New Year’s Day) on top of PTO and paid holidays
* Other perks including an Equinox membership, 401k, and commuter benefits (US employees)
* Unlimited\* access to tokens for ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, etc. \**By unlimited, we mean no one on our token usage leaderboard has ever hit a limit. So we have no idea what the limit is.*

**Compensation**
----------------

Actual offers are adjusted for experience and location, but our base salary bands are

* San Francisco (and other major US cities): $95,000 - $165,000
* Singapore: $70,000 - $120,000
* Rest of world: $55,000 - $120,000

Due to high volume, we may not actively respond to every application, but feel free to contact us at recruiting@hud.so or elsewhere if we missed your application!

Compensation Range: $55K - $165K

jobs.title: Sales Account Manager – Custom & Proprietary
jobs.description:
### **Sales Account Manager – Custom & Proprietary**

The Sales Account Manager for Custom & Proprietary publishing plays a critical role in driving the day-to-day execution and account management of our custom product offerings. Reporting directly to the Director of Custom Publishing, this role serves as the primary operational liaison for select retail, licensing, and brand partners. The ideal candidate will bridge client needs with internal editorial and production workflows, track data to inform executive strategy, and ensure that custom publishing projects are delivered on time, within budget, and optimized for market success.

  
  

**Strategic Oversight & Core Responsibilities**

* **Dedicated Account Management:** Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for select custom publishing clients, ensuring proactive communication, prompt issue resolution, and exceptional client satisfaction throughout the product lifecycle.
* **Relationship Building:** Create, maintain, and foster excellent personal and professional relationships with end-customer buyers as well as all product management staff.
* **Proactive Partner Strategy:** Assist brand and retail partners with proprietary products, including positioning, configuration, and sales strategy, to help drive sell-through. Continually keep customers up to date on marketing initiatives to drive demand and secure increased placement for custom titles.
* **Revenue Operations & Reporting:** Track account health, manage the intake and routing of purchase orders, and build reporting tools to monitor pipeline opportunities and project progress. Monitor, report on, and contextualize Point of Sale (POS) data by title and customer to identify performance trends.
* **Pipeline & Production Tracking:** Monitor project milestones, enforce internal timelines, and track deliverables across editorial, design, and production teams to guarantee on-time market delivery.
* **Asset Management:** Organize and manage client assets, contract routing, and approval workflows for custom proprietary products.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* **Forecasting & Operations Integration:** Collaborate with operations to provide timely print forecasts by title and account, ensuring accurate print runs for custom orders. Immediately communicate demand opportunities to the operations team and verify product availability before committing to external partners.
* **Internal Liaison:** Act as the operational bridge between the external client and internal creative/production teams, translating client feedback into actionable tasks.
* **Intake Assistance:** Support the centralized triage protocol by helping to log, track, and organize inbound partnership and custom product inquiries.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 2–4 years of experience in account management, B2B sales support, or publishing operations.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple client accounts and concurrent project lifecycles.
* Strong understanding of client relationship management, forecasting, and cross-functional team coordination.

**Veterinary Technician Learning & Development Specialist**
===========================================================

$40.00–$50.00/hour (DOE)  
Full-Time | SAGE Veterinary Centers

SAGE Veterinary Centers is seeking an experienced Veterinary Technician Learning & Development Specialist (TLDS) to support the training, development, and clinical growth of our Veterinary Technicians and Veterinary Assistants.

This is a hands-on clinical role for an experienced veterinary professional who enjoys both working on the hospital floor and developing others. The TLDS continues to work as a Veterinary Technician while helping assess clinical skills, train new team members, support onboarding, and build ongoing learning opportunities for the hospital team.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Work hands-on as a Veterinary Technician while serving as a clinical trainer and mentor for Veterinary Technicians and Veterinary Assistants.
* Assess clinical skills and provide direct, hands-on training for new and existing team members.
* Facilitate Veterinary Assistant and Veterinary Technician training across multiple skill levels.
* Develop and deliver clinical in-service training and educational sessions.
* Partner with Clinical Supervisors and hospital leadership to create individualized learning and development plans.
* Support onboarding and role-specific training across hospital departments based on operational needs.
* Track completion of clinical training, competency assessments, protocols, and required learning modules.
* Assign and support training through VetBloom, Talent Unleashed, and other learning platforms.
* Help develop and standardize clinical protocols, practical assessments, and skill sign-offs.
* Provide timely feedback to team members and leadership regarding training progress and development needs.
* Collaborate with the Ethos Clinical Learning & Development team and other clinical trainers to implement updated training programs.
* Support continuing education programs, workshops, and hospital learning initiatives.
* Promote a positive learning environment focused on clinical excellence, professional development, and patient care.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Current Registered Veterinary Technician (RVT), Certified Veterinary Technician (CVT), Licensed Veterinary Technician (LVT), or equivalent credential required.
* Advanced veterinary clinical knowledge and strong hands-on technical skills.
* Veterinary Technician Specialist (VTS) credential is a plus.
* Experience training, mentoring, precepting, or developing Veterinary Technicians and Veterinary Assistants.
* Ability to confidently perform and teach veterinary clinical skills, including patient assessment and triage, venipuncture, medication and fluid administration, CPR, and patient care.
* Strong presentation, coaching, and communication skills.
* Ability to provide constructive feedback and support employees at varying levels of clinical experience.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to track multiple training and development initiatives.
* Comfortable working independently and collaboratively with technicians, veterinarians, hospital leadership, and Learning & Development partners.
* Ability to adapt training approaches to individual learning needs and changing hospital priorities.
* Experience with veterinary electronic medical record systems and learning management systems preferred.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule based on hospital training and clinical needs.

**Benefits**
------------

Eligible full-time employees receive a comprehensive benefits package, which may include:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with employer match
* Paid time off, including vacation and sick time
* Life and disability insurance
* Continuing Education opportunities
* VetBloom learning and professional development resources
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Employee pet benefits
* Opportunities for continued professional and career development within SAGE and Ethos Veterinary Health

**About Ethos Veterinary Health**
---------------------------------

Ethos Veterinary Health, part of the NVA Group, is a network of specialty and emergency veterinary hospitals committed to advancing veterinary medicine through exceptional patient care, collaboration, education, and innovation.

As a Technician Learning & Development Specialist, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact beyond individual patient care by helping develop the Veterinary Technicians and Veterinary Assistants who support our hospitals every day.

------------------------------

jobs.description:
**Description**

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will take on a leadership role helping design solutions that streamline digital workflows for enterprise operations. You will work closely with customers, solution architects, and technical teams to translate complex business needs into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and test plans. This role requires strong business analysis experience, knowledge of agile delivery, and the ability to guide stakeholders and mentor less-experienced team members. Because customers and coworkers may work remotely, the position requires effective communication by phone and web conference. The role may also create and peer-review functional, technical, training, marketing, and proposal content. This position works with the Solution Architect to confirm the solution is technically feasible, identify ways to reduce implementation effort, define detailed user stories with acceptance criteria, and support delivery within an agile or scrum framework. The Senior Business Analyst works directly with customers and coworkers and must communicate effectively by phone and web conference. In addition to supporting all phases of the project, this position may author and peer-review functional, technical, training, marketing, and proposal content.

**What You Will Do**

* Lead discovery sessions and translate customer business needs into clear functional requirements for technical teams.
* Guide the project team in applying industry best practices and detailed business analysis knowledge to design solutions that meet or exceed functional requirements.
* Translate application functionality into solution architecture inputs and business functionality requirements.
* Document current-state and future-state workflows, business rules, decisions, and analysis results.
* Own user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional tests in line with agile best practices.
* Lead functional testing and quality reviews to confirm business and design requirements are met.
* Contribute to test-plan development and execution and help create and deliver end-user training.
* Support Organizational Change Management by clearly explaining the future-state solution and its impact.
* Build trusted relationships with customers, stakeholders, and subject-matter experts across the organization.
* Break down complex business problems, identify root causes, and recommend practical solution options.
* Mentor junior team members and promote consistent business-analysis practices across engagements.
* Apply public-health domain knowledge, when available, to accelerate discovery and solution design for public-sector health programs.

**What We Expect of You**

* Bachelor’s degree and 3+ years of experience designing and developing process workflows and drafting stories. Or, 7+ years of experience designing and developing process workflows and drafting stories.
* Experience with business analysis methods, requirements documentation, and process modeling.
* Strong working knowledge of requirements gathering software support, data mining tools, business process mapping and visual diagramming, and Microsoft Office applications
* Proven ability to elicit functional and business requirements

jobs.title: Business Analyst (NCPDP) - Remote
jobs.description:
We are a unique and innovative retail risk management and employee benefits insurance brokerage and consulting firm, founded in San Francisco, California in 2007 with offices and leadership across the country.
  
  
EPIC Insurance Brokers & Consultants has a depth of industry expertise across key lines of insurance, including risk management, property and casualty, employee benefits, unique specialty program insurance and private client services.
  
  
EPIC team members have consistently recognized their company as a 'Best Place to Work' in multiple regions and as a 'Best Place to Work in the Insurance Industry' nationally.
  
  
**Job Description:**  
The Business Solutions Analyst is a client-facing consultant who supports health plans, pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs), and other healthcare organizations through complex business and technology initiatives. Because PSG provides BA services through varied client statements of work, this role must adapt quickly across projects, delivery models, tools, and levels of detail. Depending on the engagement, the Business Solutions Analyst may support strategy, operational requirements, technical requirements, RFP evaluation, regulatory readiness, product-related work, or implementation activities such as health plan PBM migrations. The successful candidate can operate strategically with client leaders and also work in the details of workflows, files, requirements, testing, risks, and implementation decisions.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Lead discovery and analysis by asking probing questions, clarifying problems, challenging assumptions, and identifying missing information, risks, dependencies, and operational impacts.
* Translate business and operational needs into clear business, functional, data, and technical requirements at the level required by the engagement.
* Analyze current-state and future-state processes, systems, files, data exchanges, controls, and handoffs; document gaps and practical recommendations.
* Serve as a liaison among clients, health plans, PBMs, vendors, operational teams, technical teams, and project leadership to align scope, requirements, decisions, and expectations.
* Adapt BA methods and deliverables to each client and statement of work, including strategic assessments, operational transformation, regulatory initiatives, product-related support, PBM procurement, and implementation or migration programs.
* Support RFP development and evaluation by reviewing requirements and vendor responses, applying scoring criteria, documenting rationale, identifying gaps, and supporting consensus discussions.
* Facilitate client, vendor, and internal working sessions; capture decisions and actions; and drive follow-up to completion.
* Support testing and readiness activities, including test planning, test case development, traceability, defect review, evidence validation, implementation planning, go/no-go support, and stabilization.
* Create concise, client-ready deliverables that synthesize findings, options, implications, and recommendations for both executive and delivery audiences.
* Own assigned workstreams and deliverables, manage priorities and documentation, escalate concerns early, and bring recommended next steps rather than only reporting problems.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**  

* 5+ years of business analysis, consulting, implementation, or transformation experience in healthcare, including client-facing work.
* Meaningful, hands-on experience with both health plan operations and PBM operations is required. General healthcare experience alone does not meet this requirement.
* Strong knowledge of pharmacy benefit operations and the pharmacy claims lifecycle, including areas such as eligibility, benefit configuration, accumulators, formulary, utilization management, prior authorization, member services, reporting, and vendor interfaces.
* Experience supporting multiple engagement types, such as PBM implementations or migrations, health plan transformation, strategic assessments, regulatory programs, product-related initiatives, vendor selection, RFP evaluation, testing, or operational readiness.
* Experience developing and managing business, operational, functional, data, or technical requirements and supporting traceability through testing and implementation.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience required.
* Knowledge of NCPDP standards, government programs, pharmacy transaction processing, or major regulatory transitions preferred.
* Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, process-mapping tools, and advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint preferred.

**Skills & Abilities:**  

* Strong critical thinking and structured problem-solving skills, including the ability to evaluate incomplete or conflicting information and reach defensible conclusions.
* Intellectual curiosity and investigative thinking, with a demonstrated ability to ask effective follow-up questions, uncover root causes, and understand downstream impacts.
* Ability to move comfortably between strategic discussions and detailed analysis without losing the connection between business outcomes, operations, and technology.
* Consulting agility and learning agility, with the ability to transition quickly across clients, subject areas, delivery approaches, and project types with limited ramp-up time.
* Strong facilitation, written communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills with technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to translate complex technical information into clear operational and client-facing language, and operational needs into actionable requirements.
* High degree of ownership, sound judgment, attention to detail, and ability to move work forward independently in ambiguous environments.
* Ability to work within Agile, Waterfall, hybrid, or client-specific methodologies and use tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps when required by the engagement.

jobs.title: Account Manager (AM) – Compute
jobs.description:
**About Megaport**

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

**Our Team Culture**

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.

We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

### **Your Role**

As Latitude scales and integrates with Megaport, our current sales structure needs to evolve. We are moving away from a model where one person handles everything to a specialized Pod Model. This allows us to handle a higher volume of global customers without losing quality.

As we scale globally as part of Megaport, we’re changing how we work. We’re moving to a **"Pod Model"** where Sales, Tech, and Operations work as one, and we need an **Account Manager** to be the glue that holds it all together.

You won't just be "handling accounts." You’ll be right in the middle of the action—bridging the gap between a signed deal and a happy customer. You’ll work alongside our Sales Executives and Architects to coordinate server deployments, fix billing hurdles, and spot new ways for our international clients to grow on our platform.

If you’ve got **advanced English**, love solving puzzles, and want to see how a global cloud company actually runs from the inside, we want to talk to you.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Unblock Sales: They handle the "paperwork and chores" so the Sales team can focus 100% on closing new deals.
* Faster Delivery: They push the internal buttons to make sure customers get their servers turned on quickly, not weeks later.
* Zero Billing Drama: They fix invoice and payment issues before they become big headaches for the customer.
* Spot Easy Upgrades: Since they are close to the customer, they’ll notice when someone needs a bigger plan and flag the win.
* Order in the House: They keep our systems (CRM/Billing) clean so we actually know what’s happening as we scale.
* Sales Enablement: Act as the operational right hand for Sales Executives, managing quotes, pricing, and account updates to keep the sales cycle moving.
* Account Growth: Proactively identify expansion opportunities and suggest additional capacity or services that add tangible value to the customer’s infrastructure.
* Operational Coordination
* Project Orchestration: Coordinate server provisioning, migrations, and upgrades by working closely with internal technical teams to ensure perfect execution.
* Delivery Excellence: Track all deployments from start to finish, ensuring internal systems (CRM, tickets) stay accurate, and customers are notified of completion.
* Revenue Operations: Configure billing plans (hourly, monthly, or annual) and serve as the first point of contact for invoice queries or plan adjustments.
* Lifecycle Management: Handle account maintenance, including credits and cancellations, ensuring all changes follow company guidelines and maintain data integrity.
* The Pod Engine: Operate as a central figure in our "POD" model, collaborating daily with Sales, Solution Architects, and Ops to streamline the customer journey.
* Continuous Improvement: Follow established processes while contributing fresh ideas to help us scale more efficiently.
* Technical Mastery: Actively build your knowledge of cloud infrastructure, bare metal, and global networking services.

### **What We Are Looking For**

* Effective Communicator: You are comfortable engaging with customers and can translate internal operations into clear, professional updates.
* Meticulous Organizer: You have an eye for detail and a structured approach to work. You take pride in keeping systems accurate and ensuring no task is left unfinished.
* You are genuinely curious about the "how" behind technology. You are eager to dive into the technical and operational nuances of cloud infrastructure.
* Adaptable: You thrive in fast-paced, global environments. You can manage multiple priorities without losing your focus or your sense of humor.
* Relevant Experience: A background in Customer Success, Account Management, or Sales Support is a major advantage.
* Tech Industry Exposure: Previous experience at a cloud, hosting, or SaaS company will help you get up to speed quickly.
* Tool Proficiency: Experience navigating CRMs (like Salesforce or HubSpot), ticketing systems, or complex billing platforms.
* Technical Foundations: A basic understanding of how servers, cloud environments, or networking work (though we are happy to train the right person).

### **What We Offer**

* Flexible working environment – a remote-first culture with coworking options available
* Generous leave plans – including, parental leave, birthday leave, and a purchased annual leave program
* Health and wellness support – through a wellness allowance and employee wellbeing initiatives
* Comprehensive learning support – generous study and training allowance plus paid study leave
* Creative, modern workspaces – designed to inspire when you're not working remo

Our goal is to be the only financial partner doctors need by seamlessly integrating personal and practice-based solutions to maximize their wealth potential and drive better financial outcomes.

We are building this platform from the ground up, leveraging modern technology, data, and AI to simplify the client experience and make it easier for advisors and sales teams to deliver high-quality advice at scale. Operating across multiple service lines, acquired entities, and client entry points requires a highly disciplined yet relationship-driven go-to-market model that can scale without losing trust.

Join us as we build the future of financial services for doctors faster, smarter, and at scale.

You'll lead day-to-day accounting operations in NetSuite, including the close, cash and treasury management, and tax compliance support. You'll also help build scalable processes as we integrate newly acquired firms. This role suits someone who enjoys both doing the work and improving how it gets done.

* + Monthly flux analysis for all the related Balance Sheet accounts

  + Every newly acquired firm is fully onboarded into NetSuite and banking within the integration window.

  + Cash forecasting and bank controls are standardized across all entities.

  + The annual audit and tax filings are completed with no significant findings.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Accounting Operations & Close**

* Oversee AP, fixed assets, prepaids, and intercompany accounting, including intercompany eliminations and consolidation.
* Maintain complete, well-documented reconciliations for all balance sheet accounts, and resolve reconciling items on time.
* Prepare GAAP-compliant financial statements and flux analysis for management.

**Treasury & Cash Management**

* Manage daily cash positioning across operating accounts and entities, and prepare 13-week cash forecasts.
* Oversee bank relationships, account setup and maintenance, signatory changes, and payment controls such as dual approval and positive pay.
* Manage intercompany funding and cash transfers, and support debt covenant compliance reporting where applicable.

**NetSuite Ownership**

* Serve as the accounting team's NetSuite power user and process owner: chart of accounts, subsidiaries, saved searches, workflows, and reporting.
* Lead or support NetSuite OneWorld configuration for new subsidiaries, and drive automation such as bank feeds, amortization schedules, and approval workflows.
* Partner with other team members on integrations with payroll, billing, banking, and expense platforms.

* Coordinate with external tax advisors on federal and state income tax provisions and returns, estimated payments, and year-end tax packages.
* Manage sales and use tax, franchise tax, property tax, and business license compliance, including nexus monitoring as we expand into new states.
* Oversee 1099 reporting and support tax diligence for acquisitions.

* Design, document, and maintain internal controls over financial reporting, including segregation of duties, reconciliation review, and payment approvals.
* Prepare PBC schedules and audit-ready documentation.
* Supervise, train, and develop staff and senior accountants, and set clear close-calendar ownership and review standards.

**Key Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in accounting or finance.
* 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including 5+ years hands-on in NetSuite (OneWorld/multi-subsidiary strongly preferred).
* 5+ years of direct experience in cash/treasury management and tax compliance support.
* Strong command of US GAAP, month-end close, and account reconciliation best practices.
* Experience in a professional services, or consulting environment with recurring or service-based revenue.
* 3+ years of managing accounting staff.
* Advanced Excel skills. Comfort with saved searches and building NetSuite reports.

jobs.title: Senior Facilities Operations Manager
jobs.description:
