jobs.title: Vertical Operations Manager
jobs.description:
At UVeye, we're on a mission to redefine vehicle safety and reliability on a global scale. Founded in 2016, we pioneered the world's first fully automated suite of vehicle inspection systems. At the heart of this innovation lies our advanced AI-centric technology, representing the pinnacle of computer vision, machine learning, and generative AI within the automotive sector.

With over $380M in funding and strategic partnerships with industry giants such as Toyota, Amazon, General Motors, Volvo, and Hertz, our technology is utilized in manufacturing plants, dealerships, wholesale auctions, delivery fleets, seaports, and more. Our growing global team of 250+ employees is committed to creating a workplace that celebrates diversity, encourages teamwork, and strives for excellence.

The *Vertical Operations Manager* is accountable for the successful execution of delivery, installation, and lifecycle service activities within assigned verticals (Fleet, Rental, or Dealership). This role ensures sales commitments are executable by Operations and delivered to customers reliably and efficiently within defined SLAs.

**A day in the life and how you’ll make an impact:**

**﻿**

* Operational Accountability: Ensure the successful execution of delivery, installation, and lifecycle service activities within assigned verticals (Fleet, Rental, or Dealership). This includes delivering installations on time, maintaining SLA compliance, scaling delivery capacity, and achieving target costs.
* Delivery & Support Ownership: Oversee all aspects of planning, resource allocation, safety compliance, and quality for installations, maintenance activities. Ensure installation targets are met: 2 days for Rental/Dealership installations and 4 days for Fleet installations. Ensure that maintenance (support visits) have a clear scope of work to complete on time, with a first time right approach.
* Sales-Operations Interface: Act as the operational counterpart to the Sales and Implementation teams. This involves confirming the feasibility of sales commitments, identifying associated risks, and translating those commitments into concrete, executable operational plans.
* Field Service Leadership: Manager Field Service Engineers and Service Operations Coordinators, focusing on achieving 80% utilization, ensuring technical readiness, and developing productive capacity planning.
* Vendor Oversight: Manage installation partners and contractors. Responsibilities include continuously monitoring and evaluating vendor performance across key areas like cost, quality, and execution.
* KPI & OKR Management: Proactively achieve critical operations metrics, including on-time delivery, first-time fix rates, and target cost per install, by implementing proactive corrective actions.

  
Requirements:
  

* 5+ years of experience leading field operations, service delivery, or technical operations teams.
* Experience managing distributed Field Service Engineers (FSEs) or technical field teams.
* Experience in the automotive, fleet, rental, dealership, or a similar operational environment.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives across Sales, Customer Success, Implementation, and Operations.
* Experience with capacity planning, resource allocation, and operational forecasting.
* Strong understanding of SLAs, KPIs, and operational performance metrics.
* Experience managing high-volume deployment, installation, or field service projects.
* Experience managing third-party vendors, contractors, and installation partners.
* Proficiency with ERP, CRM, or Field Service Management (FSM) systems to manage operations and drive performance.
* Strong analytical and data-driven problem-solving skills with the ability to make operational decisions using metrics.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and escalation management skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field preferred.
* PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or other project management certifications are a plus.
* Travel to on-site locations based on business flow.

**Benefits we offer:**

* Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision.
* Company 401k Match.
* 20 PTO days, Company paid holidays.
* Career growth as we scale across the US.

**Compensation:**

UVeye provides salary ranges that comply with the New Jersey State Law on salary transparency in job advertisements. Actual salaries depend on a variety of factors, including experience, qualifications, skills, location, education, and operational needs. The salary range or contractual rate listed does not include bonuses/incentives or other forms of compensation or benefits. The annual base salary range for this position is $110,000 - $125,000. In addition, this position is also eligible for Bonus.

**Physical Requirements:**

This role may involve on-site or field-based activities. Depending on the position, tasks may include extended periods of sitting, standing, or walking; working in and around vehicle service areas, rental facilities, dealerships, manufacturing sites, or warehouse environments; and performing occasional manual tasks such as lifting or carrying up to 40 lbs, bending, or reaching. The role may also require travel, working in varying environmental conditions, and the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) when appropriate. *Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

**Why UVeye:**

* Pioneer Advanced Solutions: Harness cutting-edge technologies in AI, machine learning, and computer vision to revolutionize vehicle inspections.
* Drive Global Impact: Your innovations will play a crucial role in enhancing automotive safety and reliability, impacting lives and businesses on an international scale.
* Career Growth Opportunities: Participate in a journey of rapid development, surrounded by groundbreaking advancements and strategic industry partnerships.

Check out our Life at UVeye page to learn more about the

Valiss Home is a growing residential home-services company focused on delivering a better customer experience across solar, battery storage, electrical, and related home-energy services.

We are building our solar operations around clear communication, strong project management, and a high level of accountability from sale through installation and project completion.

We are looking for a Solar Project Manager who will take ownership of our customer pipeline and help make sure every project continues moving forward.

**Position Overview**

The Solar Project Manager will be responsible for managing residential solar and battery projects from the point of sale through installation, inspection, utility approval, and project completion.

This person will be the primary operational point of contact for Valiss customers and will coordinate between customers, sales representatives, installers, permitting authorities, utilities, financing partners, and internal team members.

This is not simply a scheduling position. We are looking for someone who can understand where a project is in the process, identify what is preventing it from moving forward, communicate clearly with everyone involved, and take ownership of resolving problems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the active Valiss solar and battery project pipeline from sale through project completion.
* Serve as the primary customer contact after the sale.
* Provide customers with regular and proactive project updates.
* Coordinate project handoffs from the sales team into operations.
* Review new projects to confirm required documentation and information has been received.
* Work with cities, counties, permitting authorities, and utilities to resolve project issues.
* Understand and process all residential solar permitting and utility interconnection applications.
* Coordinate with installation partners and subcontractors to keep projects on schedule.
* Identify stalled projects and take action to move them forward.
* Escalate issues when projects are at risk of delay or cancellation.
* Respond to customer questions, concerns, complaints, and project disputes.
* De-escalate difficult customer situations and work toward practical resolutions.
* Coordinate with sales representatives when customer expectations or project details need clarification.
* Maintain accurate project notes, status updates, documentation, and next steps.
* Help develop and improve Valiss project-management procedures as the company grows.
* Identify recurring operational problems and recommend process improvements.
* Ensure customers receive a consistent, professional Valiss experience throughout the project.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is organized, persistent, professional, and comfortable taking ownership of problems.

The right candidate should be able to manage many projects at different stages without losing track of details.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous residential solar project-management or solar operations experience.
* Understanding of the residential solar project lifecycle.
* Experience working with solar permitting and AHJs.
* Experience with utility interconnection and PTO processes.
* Familiarity with residential battery-storage projects is a plus.
* Experience communicating with homeowners throughout construction or installation projects.
* Experience working with sales teams, installers, subcontractors, or EPC partners.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and follow-up skills.
* Ability to manage difficult conversations professionally.
* Ability to investigate problems and determine the next action required.
* Comfortable working with CRM, project-management, and cloud-based software systems.
* Ability to manage a high-volume project pipeline.

**The Right Person for This Role**

You may be a strong fit if you naturally ask questions like:

* What is holding this project up?
* Who owns the next step?
* Has the customer been updated?
* What does the utility still need?
* Why has the permit not been approved?
* What needs to happen to get this installed?
* What can I do today to keep this project moving?

We want someone who takes ownership rather than simply documenting that a problem exists.

**Customer Experience**

Customer communication is a major part of this position.

Solar projects involve multiple parties and can take weeks or months to complete. Customers need someone who understands their project and can clearly explain what is happening.

The Solar Project Manager will be expected to communicate proactively, set realistic expectations, respond quickly when issues arise, and help resolve disagreements before they become larger problems.

**Compensation**

**Up to $20 per hour**, depending on experience.

**Growth Opportunity**

Valiss Home is in an early growth stage, and this position will play an important role in building our project-management operation.

As project volume grows, there may be opportunities for increased responsibility within operations and project management.

Pay: $20.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
### **About Breaktime Media**

We help shoppers figure out what to buy and where to buy it. We build highly personalized, engaging content for the world's biggest CPG brands, with a focus on commerce conversion. Our work runs across retail media networks, brand sites, and loyalty ecosystems, and it reaches millions of shoppers making real decisions.

### **The role**

Breaktime is scaling, and our most ambitious work sits in promotions, loyalty hubs, retail media work and new innovation programs. We ran roughly 30 of these programs this year, they keep getting bigger, and the appetite from our brand partners is only growing. These are the programs that move the needle for our clients and for us.

We're building a dedicated program management role to match that ambition. You will own how these programs get executed: the plan, the deadlines, the dependencies, and the accountability that makes it all come together. Not the client relationship and not the creative, but the operating system across it all.

You will report to our Associate Director, Program Management, who will train you directly and work with you to build out a focused process and ramp you up on a set of programs. You will have real ownership from the start, and room to shape how this function works as we grow.

### **What you'll own**

* End to end program management for promotions, sweepstakes, loyalty hubs, omni retail media programs and custom programs that go beyond our standard content units
* Building and maintaining program timelines, from sold to live to wrap, with clear owners and dates at every step
* Task ownership across internal teams, so client services, creative, marketing and development all know what they owe and when
* Running program status meetings and keeping stakeholders honest about risk before it becomes a problem
* Partnering with client services on kickoff calls and status calls for our most complex programs
* Promotional terms and legal review deadlines, making sure nothing goes live without the right approvals in place
* Prize sourcing, ordering, and fulfillment tracking for sweepstakes and giveaways
* Facilitate and oversee Receipt Verification approval process, monitoring operations to ensure smooth program performance and reward delivery
* Documenting how we run programs, so the second one is easier than the first and the tenth is easy for anyone

### **What we're looking for**

* 3 to 5 years of project or program management experience, ideally in marketing, retail media, promotions, or agency environments
* A track record of running multiple concurrent projects with real deadlines and multiple stakeholders
* Comfort with promotional mechanics: sweepstakes, contests, rebates, loyalty offers, and the legal and operational requirements that come with them
* Strong written communication, because most of this job is making sure people know what is expected of them
* Someone who chases loose ends without being asked and follows up without being annoying
* Calm under pressure, and willing to raise a hand early when something is off track
* Experience with project management tools (ex: Atlassian, Asana or similar) and a bias toward making process simpler, not heavier

### **Nice to have**

* CPG or retailer experience, especially with Walmart, Target, Kroger, or Amazon programs
* Familiarity with loyalty platforms or shopper marketing programs
* Experience building a process from scratch rather than inheriting one
* CAPM or PMP certification

**Job Title**: Project Manager / Business Analyst – Healthcare Interoperability & Claims (837/835/276/277, Medicare & Medicaid)

**Location**: Remote (United States)  
**Employment Type**: Contract, Long-Term (W2)  
**Pay Rate**: $30–$60/hr (W2), based on experience  
**Posted by**: TAP Innovations, LLC

**Overview**  
TAP Innovations is placing a senior Project Manager / Business Analyst with a client building a cloud-based healthcare platform for skilled nursing and senior living operators. The platform covers the clinical record, healthcare data exchange, and the full medical billing cycle. This is a hands-on role for someone who can run delivery and write the requirements. It is not a generalist PM seat. The client intends this to be a long-term engagement.

**What You'll Do**  
- Plan and run delivery of interoperability and claims features: scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, and release readiness.  
- Run sprint ceremonies and backlog grooming with a distributed engineering team.  
- Coordinate clearinghouse onboarding, payer and EDI enrollment, and trading partner testing.  
- Report status to client leadership: what is on track, what is at risk, and what decision is needed.  
- Perform current-state and gap analysis of billing, claims, and data-exchange workflows in skilled nursing and senior living.  
- Turn payer rules, companion guides, and Medicare/Medicaid policy into user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, and data mappings.  
- Define requirements across the claim lifecycle: eligibility (270/271), authorization (278), claim submission (837I/837P), acknowledgements (TA1, 999, 277CA), claim status (276/277), and remittance (835).  
- Specify Medicare logic (Part A skilled stays, PDPM/HIPPS, consolidated billing, Part B, Medicare Advantage) and Medicaid logic (state variation, patient liability, managed Medicaid).  
- Define coordination of benefits for dual-eligible residents, plus denial management and A/R requirements (CARC/RARC, timely filing, aging).

- Excellent communication with executives, clinicians, billing staff, and engineers.

**Strong Plus**

- Exposure to state Medicaid MMIS, managed Medicaid, or Medicare Advantage authorization workflows.

jobs.title: Senior Security Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Concord Technologies**

Our fax-delivery suite of products allows our clients to exchange millions of patient information, insurance and other documents safely, swiftly and securely every business day. Concord’s use of Artificial Intelligence, analytics, and other cutting-edge technology also analyzes the data being transferred within a fax, then delivers it into the right inboxes and workflows, fundamentally changing how data moves.

More than 2,300 healthcare organizations, financial providers, and companies in other equally document-intensive industries trust Concord to deliver their confidential and sensitive information. We care about our customers, and with a retention rate of more than 98%, it’s clear they love the service and value we provide.

We have been in business since 1996 and growing faster than ever. Our products are getting smarter, our customers are getting bigger, and our user community is exploding. To continue meeting market demand and anticipating our customers’ needs, we are expanding our offerings. That means assembling a world-class team to take us through this next phase of growth. We hope you’d like to join us!

**About the role**

Concord is seeking a Senior Security Program Manager to bring structure, visibility , and

disciplined execution to our enterprise security program. Reporting to the CISO, this role

serves as the CISO's operational partner and leads Concord's security program

management office (PMO) function, acting as the connective tissue between security

strategy and execution across Concord's distributed security functions. In this role, you

will serve as Concord's: 1) Security Program & Portfolio Lead- responsible for the

planning, coordination, and delivery of enterprise security , compliance, and customer

trust initiatives across the enterprise, and 2) Security Governance & Operations Lead-

establishing the governance forums, processes, metrics, and financial management

practices that give leadership clear , credible, and timely insight into security program

performance, risk posture, and investment. This role requires strong program

management, facilitation, and communication skills, working knowledge of security and

compliance frameworks, and the ability to influence without direct authority in a

regulated healthcare technology environment.

**Essential Functions:**

**Security Program & Cross-Functional Execution**

* Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of enterprise security initiatives across Concord's distributed security functions, spanning strategic security , compliance, and customer trust priorities
* Own the integrated security roadmap and project portfolio, translating strategic objectives into sequenced milestones, workstreams, decision points, and measurable outcomes
* Manage project intake, prioritization, and scheduling for security initiatives, as well as IT and business-owned projects with security interests
* Coordinate dependencies, handoffs, and critical path activities related to security initiatives across the enterprise, working with partner functions such as Technology, Product, Engineering, Legal, Privacy , Compliance, Operations, and Finance

  

* Identify, track, and manage risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies, and proactively escalate critical obstacles associated with all security-related projects and initiatives
* Drive accountability and execution discipline across initiative owners and delivery partners without becoming the project manager for every individual effort

**Security Governance, Change Management & Cross-Functional Visibility**

* Implement and lead a Security Change Advisory Board (CAB) to review , assess, and approve security-relevant changes across Concord's environments
* Establish and facilitate security governance committees and leadership reviews, with clearly defined decision rights, escalation paths, and operating rhythms
* Maintain disciplined tracking of decisions and action items to ensure security priorities are effectively assessed, communicated, and managed
* Develop and maintain security metrics, KPIs/KRIs, and executive dashboards that provide actionable insight into security program performance, risk posture, compliance status, and progress against strategic initiatives
* Prepare EL T reporting, executive updates, and decision materials that synthesize complex program information into clear , concise narratives

**Security Process, Documentation & Program Enablement**

* Lead the development, standardization, and maintenance of security processes, procedures, standards, playbooks, RACI matrices, operating models, and program documentation across Concord's distributed security functions
* Establish consistent program management methodologies, reporting practices, and delivery expectations across security functions
* Identify process gaps and drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance consistency , accountability , scalability , operational efficiency , and overall security program maturity

**Cross-Functional Security Planning, Budget & Operational Management**

* Support the CISO in the planning, coordination, and management of the security operating plan, vendor portfolio (including contracts, licensing, and renewals), resource allocation and capacity , and operational priorities

  

* Manage the security budget lifecycle in partnership with Finance, including annual planning, forecasting, variance analysis, and spend reporting, to provide financial visibility and accountability
* Coordinate annual and quarterly planning activities and help prioritize security investments and resources based on business objectives, risk, compliance requirements, and strategic priorities
* Develop business cases and ROI analyses to support security investment decisions and ensure spending remains aligned with approved budgets, program objectives, and organizational priorities

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Information T ech

jobs.title: EverPro - Implementation Manager (Remote, US)
jobs.description:
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end-to-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here: https://www.evercommerce.com/about-us/careers/

**EverPro,** a business within EverCommerce, provides software and solutions designed to help home and field service businesses run and grow their companies with greater efficiency and confidence. EverPro brings together purpose-built tools across key trades—including field service, remodeling and roofing, landscaping, and pest and lawn—so service professionals can manage operations, engage customers, and drive long-term growth.

Our solutions support the full lifecycle of running a service business, from scheduling and dispatching work, to estimating, invoicing, and payments, to customer communication, reputation management, and business insights. Together, these connected solutions help service pros win more jobs, save time, and build stronger, more resilient businesses.

Briostack, part of EverCommerce, is looking to hire motivated, goal oriented, and dependable people to expand our Client Services team. As a **Customer Implementation Manager**, you will have an advanced focus on high-profile and enterprise customers that will require a special touch and the ability to connect. You will manage account implementation from sign-on through the transition to a (CAM) Customer Account Manager. This includes providing onboarding, support, training, and guidance through the adoption of Brio, our SAAS-based ERP designed specifically for pest control companies. This role is primarily responsible for the period of time that will most greatly impact the success of a customer. This is a high-touch position with a strong need for understanding customer progression through implementation. We are looking for individuals who are willing to take on large tasks and manage every aspect of our onboarding process.

Briostack is a small but quickly growing software as a service company. We have a software suite targeted at the major business needs of pest control companies. Our goal is to build software so good that no one can offer a close substitute, and we are building a world-class engineering team to help us achieve it. Our product offering is named Brio, and there are a number of major parts to what it does:

* Sales Support
* Customer Relationship Management
* Appointment Scheduling
* Route Optimization
* End to End Paperless Documentation
* Billing and Transaction Processing
* Automated Notifications

**Responsibilities:**

* Train customers to make a transition from old to new ways of thinking
* Consult with customers to understand their business and recommend best practices in the use of the software
* Handle customer support calls during the Engagement process
* Train customers and their staff in the use of the software both on-line and in person.
* Manage a data migration with high attention to detail
* Nurture customer relationships to build trust
* Participate in the ongoing creation and updating of best practices for role and department
* Operate across department boundaries
* Consistently increase your knowledge of the software and the industry
* Collaborate with other departments when necessary to help the customer be successful
* Potentially some travel
* Willingness to work over 40 hours when necessary
* Help Customers become an expert on the product which includes using all features to the fullest.

**Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:**

* Delivery of technology training in a corporate setting in-person and via the web
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects with tight deadlines
* Customer service/support
* High attention to detail
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Project development
* Bachelors degree or associate degree with comparable experience
* Working well across departments
* Ability to prioritize and organize tasks
* Data conversion or migration experience preferred
* Software implementation experience preferred

  

**Where:** Remote US
  
The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States– if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.

  

**Benefits and Perks**

* Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid
* Day 1 access to a robust health and wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend
* 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting

jobs.title: Laboratory Assistant Project Manager- Geotechnical
jobs.description:
Colliers Engineering & Design is seeking a Laboratory Assistant Project Manager to support the day-to-day operations of our high-volume Geotechnical and Construction Materials Testing Laboratory in Totowa, NJ. This role is ideal for a laboratory professional with strong geotechnical testing experience or a geotechnical engineer with experience in using testing data who is ready to take on greater leadership and project management responsibilities. Working alongside the Laboratory Manager, you'll assist with overseeing laboratory operations, manage testing programs, support staff development, coordinate multiple projects, and ensure quality, safety, and efficiency across the lab. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys a mix of technical work, team leadership, problem-solving, and client interaction, while growing their career within a collaborative and expanding team. We are open to considering qualified candidates who are willing to relocate for this opportunity, and relocation assistance may be available for the right candidate.

  

* Under the guidance of the Laboratory Manager, assists with efficient daily and long-term management of the Geotechnical and Construction Material.
* Laboratory operations including but not limited to supervising staff working in the lab, training, maintenance of laboratory equipment, quality assurance, safety and productivity of the laboratory.
* Project management of multiple projects including budget control, control costs, staffing, testing and lookahead coordination.
* Manage, oversee, perform testing and submit testing results for rock, advanced, specialized and research testing which consists of the following testing but not limited to triaxial (UC, UU, CU, CD), direct shear, direct simple shear (DSS), cyclic DSS and triaxial, permeability, special mix testing (soil, cement, bentonite, etc.) and rock (slake, uniaxial, triaxial, shear).
* Generate, calculate and compile laboratory testing reports and issue to clients.
* Assist in maintaining and organizing the laboratory workload to meet given deadlines and proactive in assessing bottlenecks in workflows and processes to ensure efficient laboratory operations.
* Experience with MS Excel to generate lab testing reports is essential.
* Assist with entering lab units and billing information.
* Assist with overseeing and providing training for existing and entry-level staff and maintains training documentation to ensure that all testing methods are performed in a safe and reliable manner.
* Assist with internal and external communication with outside clients and CED staff.
* Mechanically inclined to help with equipment trouble shooting and repairs is prefered.
* Assist with ensuring that lab is clean, organized and adequately stocked including but not limited to supply inventory, labeling and record keeping procedures.
* Assist with overseeing lab safety and lab SOP (standard operating procedures) including but not limited to proper specimen and chemical handling, disposal and storage processes and procedures.
* Communicating effectively and efficiently with contractors, clients and team members.
* Work Environment may include moderate to loud noise, dusty conditions, and require standing for extensive periods of time. Occasionally lifting and carrying objects weighing up to 40 lbs. Requires corrected vision, color perception and hearing to normal range.
* Weekend and overtime work is required as needed based on laboratory workload; some limited overnight and interstate travel may be required with this position.
* Performs other work-related duties as assigned. The omission of specific responsibilities does not preclude the laboratory manager from assigning duties that are logically related to the position.

  

* BA/BS in a related discipline (BS in civil engineering preferred) or equivalent experience.
* Experience in the Geotechnical Engineering field is preferred.
* Master’s degree or higher in a relevant area is preferred but not required.
* Professional Engineer (PE) license is preferred but not required.
* 5+ years’ experience in geotechnical laboratory experience or geotechnical engineering.
* ACI Aggregate Base Testing Technician and NICET certifications are preferred. If you do not have the required certifications you will need to acquire them within 1 year of your start date.
* Experience in soil and rock laboratory work is preferred.
* MS Excel and Word.
* Geosystems experience.
* Ability to read, write and understand English for purposes of comprehending written job-related communications and verbal instructions and interactions.

Compensation: $65,000 to $90,000 annually (depending on qualifications)

* Coordinate dependencies between HR SMEs, product owners, engineering, data, security, and vendors.
* Support with tracking of benefits realization, milestones, risks, and interlocks across a multiyear roadmap.
* Establish program governance, reporting, and executive level updates.
* Ensure alignment between delivery, change readiness, and operational adoption.

To perform this job successfully, an individual will need to perform each crucial duty satisfactorily. * 8+ years of senior project or program management experience in enterprise transformation.

* Strong understanding of Agile / hybrid delivery in regulated enterprise environments.
* Experience working with HR, shared services, or employee facing platforms strongly preferred.

**Why CBRE**

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.

**Our Values in Hiring**

At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE:CBRE), a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas, is the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm (based on 2024 revenue). jobs.title: Executive Care Coordinator, Bilingual
jobs.description:
Valeris is a fully integrated life sciences commercialization partner that provides comprehensive solutions that span the entire healthcare value chain. Formed by the merger of PharmaCord and Mercalis, Valeris™ revolutionizes the path from life sciences innovation to real-life impact to build a world in which every patient gets the care they need. Valeris works on behalf of life sciences companies to improve the patient experience so that patients can access and adhere to critical medications. Backed by proven industry expertise, a deep commitment to patient care, the latest technology, and exceptionally talented team members, Valeris provides the data and strategic insights, patient support services and healthcare provider engagement tools to help life sciences companies successfully commercialize new products. Valeris provides commercialization solutions to more than 500 life sciences customers and has provided access and affordability support to millions of patients. The company is headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina and Jeffersonville, Indiana. To learn more about Valeris, please visit www.valeris.com.

**Candidate must be fluent in Spanish/English.**

  

**The 8:00 AM - 4:30 PM ET shift is required for this role.**

  

When you join the team as an Executive Care Coordinator, you'll have the opportunity to make a difference in the lives of our patients each day as they look to you as part of their dedicated support team for helping them navigate the tricky process of getting access to their complex medication. The MRC (Medical) Operations Lead is an all-encompassing role responsible for the daily operational oversight and logistical execution of the medical Material Review Committee (mMRC). It ensures the timely, compliant, and high-quality review of medical and scientific materials, and carries a critical compliance responsibility for adherence to applicable laws, regulations, and SOPs governing the Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) review process. The Lead will continuously optimize the effectiveness of mMRC operations by evolving processes, governance, and enabling technologies to drive speed, accountability, and operational excellence, while supporting the client’s broader commercialization and growth objectives.

* Operational Execution

* Manage the end-to-end execution of mMRC operations, including agenda management, meeting facilitation, workflow routing, and quality control across Veeva Vault PromoMats and MedComms.
* Triage materials and progress workflow, overseeing submission intake, review readiness, and material QC to ensure only review-ready materials advance, protecting reviewer time and cycle-time targets.
* Manage volume projections and capacity planning; partner with stakeholders to address material volume fluctuations and forecasting needs.

* Governance & Compliance

* Own adherence to SOPs and governance standards for medical material review; track compliance, identify gaps, and facilitate remediation as necessary.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for operational risks, bottlenecks, send-back decisions, and workflow issues, operating to a defined escalation matrix and escalating to Director as appropriate.
* Enforce metadata standards, referencing requirements, and submission readiness criteria to drive first-time-right quality and approval efficiency.

* Stakeholder & Medical-Strategy Facilitation

* Act as the primary point of contact and operational liaison between Brand/Medical teams, Medical Directors, Project Owners, Agencies, and Reviewers.
* Integrate into weekly functional meetings across the medical affairs and evidence-generation community (excluding leadership forums such as IST and USLT).
* Facilitate concept consultation and pre-clearance forums, operationalizing Medical Directors’ strategic direction into actionable content and process guidance (facilitating, not setting, medical strategy).
* Drive Project Owner and Agency adherence to timelines, forecasting schedules, and processes as determined by MLR stakeholders; escalate non-compliance.

* Provide daily direction and support to coordinators, agencies, and internal partners on mMRC execution and process adherence.
* Oversee coordination activities, align on escalation and send-back decisions (including Rule-of-5 application), and manage level-ups and expedited requests to ensure appropriate escalation and alignment.
* Lead operational forums — tracker calls, planning and prioritization meetings, and content alignment touchpoints.

* Reporting, Metrics & Continuous Improvement

* Own operational KPIs, dashboards, and performance reporting — cycle times, forecasting accuracy, quality trends, and resource utilization.
* Establish and maintain agency scorecards, recurring-issue tracking, and accountability measures; support Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).
* Improve forecasting processes and tooling, reducing reliance on manual methods and strengthening capacity modelling and operational visibility.
* Support the development and maintenance of training content, process documentation, reference materials, and onboarding guidelines; drive a continuous-improvement culture.

jobs.description:
Summary
  
Altus Biologics is dedicated to every client and patient through its management of the administrative aspects of our physician’s biologic therapy practices. Our clinical professionals and administration staff are experienced and achieve desired results. We have a team environment that is filled with motivated, hard-working, and joyful employees ready to help our physicians and patients. Altus fosters opportunities for development and would like to provide you a real chance to make a difference.
  
The Clinical Support Coordinator serves as a key support role to the Clinical Director of Infusion Therapy by providing high-level administrative, operational, and clinical coordination. This position bridges communication between leadership, clinical staff, patients, and external partners to ensure the seamless delivery of infusion services. The coordinator plays an integral part in day-to-day operations, quality tracking, scheduling, documentation, and regulatory compliance.
  
Responsibilities
  

* Assist the Clinical Director with planning, organizing, and executing departmental initiatives.
* Coordinate daily clinical operations including provider and nursing schedules, patient flow, and resource allocation.
* Manage the Clinical Director’s calendar, schedule meetings, and coordinate communications across departments.
* Prepare meeting agendas, take minutes, and assist with follow-up on key action items.
* Draft, format, and edit reports, presentations, and clinical communications.
* Act as a central point of contact for patient escalations, physician communication, and referral coordination.
* Support onboarding, training coordination, and scheduling for new clinical staff.
* Facilitate internal communications and announcements to ensure alignment across the infusion team.
* Assist with the training of Medical Assistants and Medical Receptionists
* Track clinical quality indicators, staff competencies, incident reports, and patient satisfaction data.
* Assist in the preparation for audits, inspections, and regulatory reviews.
* Maintain accurate, confidential records in alignment with HIPAA and internal compliance standards.
* Manage clinical databases, patient logs, scheduling systems, and electronic health record (EHR) updates.
* Run and compile regular reports for productivity, quality assurance, and patient outcomes.

Minimum Requirements
  

* High school diploma, GED, or higher
* 2 or more years of experience in healthcare administration or clinical support roles
* 2 or more years of experience with EHR/EMR platforms
* Ability to travel 10% of the time

Preferred Requirements
  

* Associate’s degree or higher in health administration, nursing, or related field
* Medical Assistant Certificate
* Infusion or ambulatory care experience
* Experience supporting nursing or medical leadership

The **Encounter Data Submissions Program Manager** will assist in the development of an end to end Encounter Data Submission and Reconciliation program, to include creation of program guide and standard operating procedures. The program manager will collaborate across teams to better understand and evaluate ROI of existing Alternate Submission Method (ASM) workstreams, as well as potential ROI improvements as a result of workflow efficiencies and enhancements. Additionally, once established, the program manager will oversee daily EDS and reconciliation processes.

This **Manager** will lead the design and implementation of Aledade’s end-to-end Encounter Data Submission and Reconciliation program, including the creation of comprehensive program guides and Standard Operating Procedures. You will act as a cross-functional leader, evaluating the ROI of existing **Alternate Submission Method (ASM)** workstreams and driving workflow enhancements that directly improve data accuracy and operational efficiency.

Once established, you will provide oversight of the daily EDS and reconciliation processes, ensuring that clinical encounter data—the lifeblood of value-based care—is accurately captured, validated, and submitted to payers and CMS with total integrity.

  

**We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US.**

### **Primary Duties**

* Assist in the development of programming documentation and SOPs, to include routine maintenance and update of program documents

  + Identify and establish ASM process with additional eligible payers
  + Provide support to CSO in efforts to increase practice “opt-in” to ASM processes
* Create and transmit ASM files to all relevant payers on an established cadence

  + Maintain annual CMS and payer submission deadlines
  + Maintain and update payer specific ASM templates annually
  + Maintain and update payer specific submission methods annually
* Reconcile ASM record submissions with payer and CMS EDS files

  + Establish routine reconciliation process with payer and CMS files
  + Integrate accepted ASM submitted diagnosis data into existing risk reporting dashboards
* Provide ongoing monitoring of provider diagnosis submission and truncation trends

  + Develop process for consistent monitoring of existing dropped diagnosis and truncation dashboards for early identification of diagnosis submission errors
* Collaborate with senior leadership and legal partners to ensure continued compliance with regulatory requirements pertaining to submission of “add” and “delete” diagnoses
* Develop a process to identify and submit diagnoses appropriately identified through routine CDI chart audits.
* Conduct annual ROI evaluation of ASM processes to include both submission of “dropped” diagnoses, and retrospective chart audit projects
* Other duties as assigned.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Information Technology, Analytics, Operations, or a related field
* 4+ years of experience with Medicare Advantage or ACA encounter data processes and/or risk adjustment experience with a Payer, Vendor or Provider Organization
* 1+ years of X-12 837 data knowledge
* Strong analytical skills with a proven ability to interpret complex data sets and identify key insights
* Ability to develop and present information to Senior Leadership
* Working knowledge of SQL: writing, creating and/or running queries
* Software Proficiency: Proficiency in using common business software such as *Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint),* collaboration tools (e.g., *SharePoint*), and project management software (e.g., *Jira, Smartsheet*)

### **Preferred knowledge, skills, and/or abilities**

* Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal
* Business Process Reengineering (BPR): Familiarity with BPR principles and methodologies to radically redesign business processes for improved performance, efficiency, and customer satisfaction
* Medicare claims experience
* Fundamental understanding of relational databases

### **Physical Requirements**

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.

**What Does This Mean for You?**

At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.

Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles

Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners

As a **Referral PCC**, you will be the first point of contact for patients referred to Talkiatry by our trusted network of partners, and you'll also manage the outbound side of referrals - coordinating when Talkiatry patients need to be referred out to partner organizations for services outside our scope of care. This is a patient-facing role that blends administrative efficiency, sales acumen, and cross-organizational coordination to keep referrals moving smoothly in both directions.

The successful candidate must be available to work one of the following shifts:

8:00am-4:30pm EST

10:30am-7:00pm EST

  

**About Talkiatry**
-------------------

Talkiatry is transforming mental health care by making high-quality psychiatry more accessible, human, and sustainable for both patients and clinicians. Co-founded by a patient and a triple-board-certified psychiatrist, we were built to solve one of healthcare’s most urgent challenges: millions of people struggle to access mental health care, while clinicians face growing administrative burden and burnout. Through our technology-powered, in-network platform, we’re changing that, creating a better experience for patients and empowering clinicians to focus on delivering exceptional care.

  

Today, Talkiatry is the largest dedicated psychiatry practice in the U.S., with 750+ psychiatrists, 250+ therapists, and more than two million patient visits delivered nationwide. At our scale, every innovation has real impact. Every workflow we improve, every technology solution we build, and every patient experience we redesign helps thousands of clinicians provide better care to hundreds of thousands of patients. We’re not just growing quickly — we’re redefining how behavioral healthcare is delivered in America.

  

Joining Talkiatry means joining a mission-driven team that is solving complex problems at scale, driving meaningful change in healthcare, and building the future of mental health care with compassion, innovation, and purpose.

**You will:**
-------------

* **Inbound Referral Outreach & Scheduling**

  + Manage referral workflow by initiating outreach on all referrals not yet scheduled and tracking outcomes accurately
  + Manage a high volume of outbound calls in a fast-paced environment
  + Contact referred patients via phone, text, and email to explain next steps, highlight the value of care with Talkiatry, and assist with scheduling
  + Use motivational interviewing techniques to address concerns, build urgency, and motivate patients to schedule their psychiatric evaluations
  + Coordinate scheduling using internal scheduling tools and match patients with appropriate Talkiatry psychiatrists based on need, geography, and insurance
  + Send self-scheduling links, follow up, and troubleshoot scheduling barriers (insurance questions, availability, etc.)
* **Outbound Referral Coordination**

  + Manage the outbound referral process for Talkiatry patients being referred to partner organizations for services outside Talkiatry's scope of care (e.g., higher level of care, specialized programs, community resources)
  + Communicate directly with patients about the outbound referral: explaining why the referral is being made, what to expect, and next steps for connecting with the receiving partner
  + Coordinate with the partner organization to confirm receipt of the referral, submit any required documentation, and track the patient's status through intake
  + Keep the Talkiatry referring provider updated on the status of the outbound referral, including confirmation of receipt, scheduling outcomes, and any barriers encountered
  + Follow up with patients and partners to close the loop on outbound referrals, ensuring patients don't fall through the cracks between organizations
  + Document all outbound referral activity accurately in internal systems to maintain a clear audit trail for the care team

**You have:**
-------------

* 1–3 years' experience in healthcare coordination, patient intake, call center, or referrals
* Experience coordinating care or referrals across multiple organizations or provider networks a plus
* Ability to communicate clearly, both verbally and in writing
* Sales or customer retention experience strongly preferred (e.g., upselling, rebooking, or high-volume conversion roles)
* Strong phone presence, empathy, and a persuasive communication style
* Comfortable working with CRMs, EHRs (eClinicalWorks), ticketing systems (Zendesk/ServiceNow)
* Ability to multitask and work efficiently in high-volume environments
* Must be organized, responsive, and detail-oriented with strong follow-through

**Why Talkiatry:**
------------------

* Top-notch team: we're a diverse, experienced group motivated to make a difference in mental health care
* Collaborative environment: be part of building something from the ground up at a fast-paced startup
* Excellent benefits: medical, dental, vision, effective day 1 of employment, 401K with match, generous PTO plus paid holidays, paid parental leave, and more!
* Grow your career with us: hone your skills and build new ones with our Learning team as Talkiatry expands
* It all comes back to care: we’re a mental health company, and we put our team’s well-being first

To strengthen care delivery and improve lives, vital information is preserved and managed by HHIT in a way that keeps it accessible, releasable, usable, interoperable, secure, and compliant.

HHIT has established core values for the workplace. This helps to maintain a culture of excellence and provides guidance in our daily work.

**HHIT’s core values are:**

* Do the right thing
* Be easy to work with
* Exceed expectations
* Serve humbly
* Never stop improving

This role is involved in the customer hand-off and walk-through of delivered HDA system as well as the customer follow up and confirmation of successful system usage. This position requires interaction with Data Integration Specialists, who create the HDA from the defined specifications. This position is an in-office, in-person, or hybrid role if local to South Bend, or remote if not local to South Bend.

* Understand project specific Statement of Work (SOW) and how it correlates to overall project scope and related deliverables, including formal identification of out-of-scope requests
* Lead implementation planning meetings to determine data and HDA configuration needs prior to system build and delivery for Health Data Transformer (HDT) and standard archive packages; and other projects as assigned
* Conduct discussions with customers to define and document legacy system usage and understand current and go-forward workflow needs
* Create Health Data Archiver (HDA) specifications based on the statement of work and information obtained during customer planning activities
* Work with customers to identify training needs and adapt training content to meet those needs
* Perform validation of HDA application and documentation system findings
* Conduct customer training
* Build project specific test plans for use in customer validation
* Assist clients and the Data Integrity Team with customer validation efforts
* Conduct production validation on deployed HDA data sources
* Facilitate and conduct delivery of deployed data sources to customer stakeholders
* Assist Implementation Consultants with customer 30-day post-deploy HDA support (aftercare)
* Take ownership for ensuring timely completion of executable project tasks
* Always provide excellent customer service and communicate with clients and internal team members in a courteous, responsive, and helpful manner
* Participating in committees as requested

##### **Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Excellent communication skills both written and spoken
* Strong problem solving and analysis skills
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
* Excellent time management skills
* Team player
* Drive to complete project work on time
* Ability to effectively prioritize and handle multiple tasks and projects
* Travel required as needed

##### **Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Products

##### **Other:**

* Willing and ready to exemplify HHIT’s core values on a daily basis
* Responsible for protecting data entrusted to HHIT by customers or other parties by strictly adhering to HHIT’s data security and privacy policies and procedures, as well as HIPAA, PIPEDA and all other applicable law.
* Speaking and writing English is a requirement for this position
* Must be authorized to work in the United States

* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer

jobs.title: Digital Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Lumistry**

Lumistry serves over 9,000 pharmacies globally, helping them transform their businesses to improve adherence, reduce operating costs and increase revenue. We offer a collection of solutions purpose-built for pharmacies, enabling our customers to engage with their patients, consolidate vendors, improve patient health literacy, automate tasks and initiate online scheduling for programs and services. For more information, visit lumistry.com.

### **The Opportunity**

As a Digital Implementation Specialist, you'll build, review, test, and launch the websites and digital products our pharmacy customers rely on. Your job is to make sure every site is accurate, functional, polished, and ready for launch. You'll also keep Digital operations running day to day, from setting up domain-based email to handling product teardowns. You'll do well if you love details, take ownership, and keep work moving without lowering the bar. You'll find and fix issues, improve our processes, and look for ways to make Lumistry's Digital products easier to use and better for customers. Our goal is for every Digital product and service to be delivered accurately, consistently, and at the quality our customers expect.

### **What You'll Own**

**Website Delivery and Support**

* Build and deploy customer websites in Replit, following Lumistry standards, build processes, and customer requirements.
* Review completed builds for visual accuracy, layout consistency, and content quality, and make adjustments as needed.
* Migrate content, imagery, services, and functionality from customers' existing websites, and resolve anything missing or inconsistent before launch.
* Test functionality and responsiveness on desktop and mobile, including navigation, links, forms, integrations, and other interactive elements.
* Hold every site to our QA standards while finding ways to improve design, usability, accessibility, and the visitor experience.
* Support enterprise and non-enterprise projects, including large-scale website migrations and other Digital initiatives.
* Help create, test, and improve website templates, standards, and build resources.
* Meet production goals, timelines, quality expectations, and SLAs.

**Digital Operations and Cross-Functional Support**

* Create and configure domain-based Google email inboxes for customers during onboarding and ongoing support.
* Monitor and complete Digital teardown requests so websites and their associated services are properly disconnected or removed.
* Identify and escalate blockers, dependencies, or issues that could affect customer timelines or service delivery.
* Monitor your assigned Salesforce queues so requests keep moving and SLAs are met.
* Maintain internal documentation and support cross-functional onboarding and training on Digital products and processes.
* Take part in audits, migrations, and special projects as assigned by Digital leadership.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

### **What You Bring**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* Experience creating, editing, or maintaining websites
* Experience using AI-powered tools, and real comfort adopting new technology
* Strong attention to detail, with an eye for visual, content, and functional inconsistencies
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, queues, and priorities at once
* Ability to troubleshoot problems and learn new technical tools and processes on your own
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-moving, evolving environment
* A track record of meeting deadlines and production and service-level expectations
* Ability to collaborate across technical and customer-facing teams

**Preferred**

* Experience with Replit and Salesforce
* Familiarity with WCAG accessibility standards, responsive web design, and SEO best practices
* Experience in a queue-based or production-oriented environment

### **Compensation**

The approximate range for this role is $58,000 to $62,000, depending on experience and skills.

### **Benefits**

Lumistry offers a comprehensive benefits package, including flexible time off; medical, dental, and vision coverage; long-term disability coverage; fitness benefits; and more.

### **Diversity and Inclusion at Lumistry**

Lumistry is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to an inclusive workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. This commitment applies to every part of employment, from recruiting and hiring to compensation and promotion. We base our decisions solely on qualifications, merit, and current business needs.

### **Accessibility**

We're happy to provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities during the application and interview process. If you need assistance, please reach out.

Ziply Fiber is a local internet service provider dedicated to elevating the connected lives of the communities we serve. We offer the fastest home internet in the nation, a refreshingly great customer experience, and affordable plans that put customers in charge.

  

As our state-of-the-art fiber network expands, so does our need for team members who can help us grow and realize our goals.

  

**Our Company Values:**

  

* **Genuinely Caring:** We treat customers and colleagues like neighbors, with empathy and full attention.

* **Empowering You:** We help customers choose what is best for them, and we support employees in implementing new ideas and solutions.

* **Innovation and Improvement:** We constantly seek ways to improve how we serve customers and each other.

* **Earning Your Trust:** We build trust through clear, honest, human communication.

The Program Manager, Fiber Design & Construction (FDC) - Subsidy Builds is a hands-on program leader responsible for planning and delivering fiber construction programs supported by federal, state and local subsidy funding. This role leads schedule, budget, location-data, milestone, risk and compliance management and partners with engineering, design, permitting, construction, operations, vendors, Finance and Regulatory & External Affairs to move subsidized builds from award through customer-ready service activation and certification.

  

This Program Manager brings structure, clarity and accountability to a complex portfolio of subsidized builds. The ideal candidate translates funding requirements, location-level data and construction dependencies into clear plans and actions while maintaining a recurring operating rhythm that keeps teams aligned, risks visible and milestone certifications audit-ready.

* Reinforce disciplined reporting through structured updates on completed work, upcoming milestones, compliance deliverables, risks and support needed.

* Develop and present executive reporting summarizing schedule performance, budget status, completed and remaining locations, compliance readiness, key risks and recovery actions.

* Maintain cross-functional alignment across engineering, design, permitting, construction, operations, vendors, Finance and Regulatory & External Affairs through recurring program reviews.

* Serve as the primary FDC program owner for assigned subsidy-funded portfolios and maintain accountability for buildout timelines, funded-location commitments, certification milestones and reporting deadlines.

* Establish recurring program, milestone, risk and compliance reviews and document decisions, owners, due dates and recovery plans.

  

**Planning & Modeling**

* Monitor contractor and vendor performance and escalate issues affecting schedule, budget, funded-location commitments or compliance requirements.

* Maintain visibility into bottlenecks, aging tasks, location discrepancies, certification dependencies and cross-functional risks.

* Coordinate removal of blockers with engineering, permitting, construction, operations, vendors and Regulatory & External Affairs.

* Partner with FDC leadership to ensure subsidized projects achieve construction completion, service activation and funded-location targets within required timeframes.

jobs.description:
**340B Program Manager**  
Remote | Full-Time

**Who We Are**

NuvemRx helps community health providers deliver on their mission by simplifying the complexity of pharmacy operations, with a suite of scalable solutions that integrate software, intelligence, and expert support to illuminate savings, expand access, and elevate patient care.

**What We Are Looking For**

At NuvemRx, we hold a high bar because our work directly impacts patient care. We look for people who embody our core values:

* **Mission Always:** Every choice is a chance to serve our customers and improve healthcare
* **Be a Pioneer:** Take initiative, solve problems, and build what does not yet exist
* **Do the Right Thing the Right Way:** Lead with integrity, compliance, and thoughtful execution
* **Stronger Together:** Own your role, collaborate deeply, and elevate the team

  

We are also a fast-growing company, which means you bring strong ownership, comfort with ambiguity, resilience, and a bias toward action.

**About the Role**

The 340B Program Manager is responsible for the oversight, administration, and ongoing compliance monitoring of the 340B Drug Pricing Program for assigned Covered Entity (CE) clients supported by NuvemRx. This position supports a variety of 340B-eligible organizations, including Federally Qualified Health Centers, Disproportionate Share Hospitals, FQHC Look-Alikes, and other eligible provider organizations.

  

The 340B Program Manager ensures program compliance with HRSA guidance, federal regulations, manufacturer requirements, and internal operational standards. This role oversees compliance monitoring activities, audit readiness, operational workflows, and program documentation while serving as a key liaison between clients and internal operational teams. The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, and capable of independently managing multiple client accounts and priorities in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

* Manage and oversee day-to-day administration of assigned 340B programs to ensure compliance with HRSA guidance and applicable federal and state regulations.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and compliance resource for assigned Covered Entities regarding 340B program operations, audit readiness, and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct routine compliance reviews, internal audits, account monitoring, reconciliations, and operational assessments to identify potential risks or compliance concerns.
* Monitor program activity, data integrity, accumulations, replenishment activity, and operational workflows to ensure compliant program administration.
* Support and manage 340B ESP submission activities and manufacturer inquiry resolution processes as needed.
* Develop, maintain, and update policies, procedures, workflows, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) to support compliant 340B program operations.

**Audit Readiness & Risk Management**

* Support preparation for HRSA audits, manufacturer audits, payer reviews, and internal compliance assessments, including documentation collection, audit support, and corrective action tracking.
* Maintain accurate, organized, and audit-ready documentation related to compliance monitoring, operational activities, and client program management.
* Analyze program data and operational performance to identify opportunities for process improvement, operational efficiency, compliant savings optimization, and risk mitigation.

**Client Engagement & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Covered Entity leadership, pharmacy operations, finance, wholesalers, manufacturers, contract pharmacies, and third-party administrators (TPAs) to support compliant and effective program operations.
* Participate in client meetings, compliance discussions, operational reviews, onboarding activities, and strategic program initiatives.
* Provide education and operational guidance to clients and internal stakeholders regarding 340B program requirements and best practices.

**What You Bring**

**Core Capabilities**

* Deep working knowledge of the 340B Drug Pricing Program, including HRSA guidance, compliance requirements, and program operations.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple client accounts and complex compliance workstreams simultaneously, with high accuracy and accountability.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret program data, identify trends, and surface actionable insights.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both frontline pharmacy staff and executive-level stakeholders.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to maintain audit-ready documentation standards.
* Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience managing 340B programs for FQHCs, DSH hospitals, FQHC Look-Alikes, or other covered entities.
* Familiarity with 340B third-party administrators (TPAs), ESP submissions, and manufacturer compliance processes.
* Experience supporting HRSA audits or internal compliance assessments.
* Background in pharmacy operations, healthcare compliance, or healthcare administration.
* Proficiency in data analysis tools and 340B software platforms.

**Who Thrives in This Role**

* You are a compliance-minded professional who takes ownership of program integrity without being prompted.
* You are energized by complex regulatory environments and find purpose in keeping programs airtight for clients that serve vulnerable patient populations.
* You proactively identify risks before they become problems and bring a clear, recommended path forward.
* You build trust with clients through consistent expertise, responsiveness, and follow-through.
* You thrive in a role that requires both deep subject matter expertise and strong cross-functional collaboration.

**Benefits**

jobs.title: Theranostics Clinical Program Manager
jobs.description:
One Physics is expanding its Theranostics Services line to grow their Theranostics portfolio and help healthcare organizations safely and successfully launch and scale radiopharmaceutical programs including Lutetium-177 (¹⁷⁷Lu), Radium-223 (²²³Ra), and Fluorine-18 (¹⁸F) based agents. We are seeking a Theranostics Clinical Program Manager with a Nuclear Medicine Technologist or Health Physicist background to help build and commercialize our Radiation Safety Theranostics services, guide current and prospective clients through theranostics readiness, and represent One Physics as a trusted technical voice in the field.

This is a hybrid clinical/commercial role: part product development, part client education and radiation safety consulting, and part market-facing thought leadership and business development. The ideal candidate has walked in the shoes of the hospitals and imaging centers we serve as a nuclear medicine technologist, radiation safety officer, or health physicist and wants to apply that expertise to help more sites launch theranostics programs safely and efficiently.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Service & Product Development**

* Support the development, refinement, and scaling of One Physics’ Radiation Safety Theranostics service offerings, including site-readiness assessments, shielding and facility design input, and radiation safety program development.
* Partner with internal operational and clinical teams to translate regulatory requirements (NRC, Agreement State, and institutional Radiation Safety Committee standards) into practical, repeatable service offerings.
* Contribute subject-matter expertise to the design of new offerings, marketing content, and training materials that support client theranostics launches.

**Client Education & Theranostics Readiness**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to current and prospective clients, educating hospital, imaging center, and health system stakeholders on the clinical, operational, and radiation-safety requirements for launching or scaling theranostics services.
* Conduct on-site and virtual readiness assessments and radiation safety testing for SPECT/Nuclear Medicine and other nuclear medicine modalities (e.g., dose calibrator checks, survey meter calibration verification, shielding/leak surveys, camera/collimator setup review) to support new radiopharmaceutical program launches.
* Guide clients through the practical steps of launching radiopharmaceutical programs, drawing on direct experience with agents such as ¹⁷⁷Lu-based therapies (e.g., Lutathera®), ²²³Ra , and ¹⁸F diagnostic agents.
* Develop and deliver training content, in-services, and readiness checklists for nuclear medicine technologists, radiation safety officers, and hospital administration.

**Marketing, Business Development & Thought Leadership**

* Support external marketing and product development initiatives, including attending and presenting at industry conferences (e.g., SNMMI, ASTRO, AHRA, RSNA, state radiation safety society meetings).
* Create thought leadership content — articles, webinars, case studies, and presentations — that positions One Physics as a leader in theranostics radiation safety.
* Develop and grow relationships with radiopharmaceutical manufacturers, distributors, GPOs, professional societies, and health system partners to expand the Theranostics segment at One Physics.
* Partner with sales and marketing leadership on lead generation, proposal support, and client-facing collateral for the Theranostics service line.
* Gather and relay client and market feedback to inform service roadmap, pricing, and go-to-market strategy.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Nuclear Medicine Technology, Health Physics, Radiologic Sciences, or a related clinical/scientific field (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
* Background as a Certified Nuclear Medicine Technologist (CNMT/ARRT-N) or Health Physicist, with hands-on clinical or radiation safety experience in a nuclear medicine or radiopharmaceutical setting.
* Direct experience supporting healthcare clients through the launch of radiopharmaceutical/theranostics programs, including agents such as Lutetium-177 (¹⁷⁷Lu), Radium-223 (²²³Ra), and Fluorine-18 (¹⁸F).
* Working knowledge of radiation safety testing and quality assurance for SPECT and other nuclear medicine imaging modalities (dose calibrators, survey instruments, shielding, camera QC).
* Strong presentation, writing, and client-facing communication skills, with comfort speaking to both clinical staff and executive stakeholders.
* Ability to travel up to 50%, including overnight and multi-day travel to client sites and conferences.
* Self-directed and comfortable operating in a field-based/remote role with minimal daily supervision.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience serving as a Radiation Safety Officer (RSO) or Authorized User support for an institutional radioactive materials license.
* Prior experience in a product management, product marketing, clinical education, or client-facing role at a radiopharmaceutical, medical device, or healthcare services company (e.g., Novartis, GE HealthCare, Cardinal Health, or similar).
* Master’s degree in Health Physics, Radiation Sciences, Healthcare Administration, MBA, or related field.
* Established relationships within the nuclear medicine, radiation safety, or theranostics community (e.g., SNMMI, HPS, AAPM).
* Experience developing marketing collateral, white papers, or conference presentations.

**What Success Looks Like in the First Year**

* Radiation Safety Theranostics service offerings are documented, standardized, and ready to scale across new client sites.
* A defined portfolio of clients has completed theranostics readiness assessments and radiation safety testing to support new program launches.

* Serve as the primary point of triage for enterprise accounts running multiple shows and events per year.
* Set and manage client expectations on scope, timelines, budgets and change orders - and deliver news early and clearly.
* Run client meetings, kickoffs and program reviews with senior and executive-level stakeholders.
* Produce polished client-facing documentation: proposals, timelines, status reports and post-show recaps.
